title: Welcome to RanEddie Docs
description: Find your way around RanEddie products and your RanEddie ID.
body:
RanEddie builds browsers, games and apps that share one account: your **RanEddie ID**.

## What you can find here
- **RanEddie ID** — creating an account, signing in, security and connected games.
- **Fizz Browser** — getting started with Fizz.
- **Snake Brawl** — playing, multiplayer and cloud saves.
- **Support** — answers to common questions and how to reach us.

## Need help?
If you can't find what you're looking for, email [contact@raneddie.com](mailto:contact@raneddie.com).

## Browse by product
- [Fizz Browser](/docs/fizz-overview) — A fresh way to explore the web — a faster, more personal browsing experience with rewards built into the journey.
- [Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-overview) — Classic Snake meets arena combat. Grow, shoot, charge your Super and be the last snake standing while the poison closes in.
- [BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-overview) — BlueBear Media is RanEddie's entertainment company — film, television, streaming, animation, music and theme parks under one roof.
- [Lu](/docs/lu-overview) — Lu is RanEddie's family of devices — phone, tablet, watch, earbuds, streamer, laptop and home speaker — designed to work as one.
- [RanEddie Part](/docs/raneddie-part-overview) — RanEddie Part is where RanEddie hardware gets a longer life — genuine parts, repairs, accessories, protection plans, trade-in and recycling.
- [SkyPear](/docs/skypear-overview) — SkyPear is a fast-food restaurant chain known for its signature pizzas on crispy tortilla or fresh dough, hot dogs, loaded fries, wraps, shakes and more.
- [workIT](/docs/workit-overview) — workIT is RanEddie's productivity suite — documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, forms and meetings that work together, with workIT Assist built in.
- [EditTime](/docs/edittime-overview) — EditTime is a complete video editor with AI built into every step — from first assembly to final colour, sound and delivery — built for professional film and television productions and creators alike.
- [RanEddie Games](/docs/raneddie-games-overview) — RanEddie Games is RanEddie's game studio and publisher — more than 50 games, made to shine on RanEddie Core, its own console.
- [Gimbly](/docs/gimbly-overview) — Gimbly is a pocket-size flying camera with a built-in stabiliser and an AI director — it launches from your palm, follows the action, frames every shot and edits the story for you.
- [Cloudly](/docs/cloudly-overview) — Cloudly is RanEddie's cloud — storage, sharing and backup for everyone, plus computing, hosting and storage infrastructure for developers and businesses.
- [RanEddie Invest](/docs/raneddie-invest-overview) — RanEddie Invest is an investing app for buying and selling stocks and ETFs, building a long-term portfolio and following the markets — with clear fees and plain-language explanations.
- [rEmail](/docs/remail-overview) — rEmail is RanEddie's email service — a clean inbox with strong spam protection, smart organisation, custom addresses and AI that helps you write and catch up.
- [baseline](/docs/baseline-overview) — baseline gives developers a complete backend in minutes — a Postgres database, authentication, file storage, realtime, edge functions and instant APIs — running on Cloudly.
- [Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-overview) — Protector Y protects computers, phones and tablets from viruses, ransomware, dangerous websites and scams, with a secure VPN and a password manager.

title: Create a RanEddie ID
description: One account for every RanEddie product.
body:
A RanEddie ID lets you sign in to RanEddie products and keep your progress and purchases safe.

## Before you start
- You need an email address you can open.
- You must be at least 13 years old.

## Create your account
1. Go to [id.raneddie.com/sign-up](https://id.raneddie.com/sign-up).
2. Enter your email and choose a password of at least 15 characters. A short phrase works well.
3. Enter your date of birth and country.
4. Complete the quick security check.
5. Pick a username — this is how other players see you.
6. Enter the 6-digit code we email you.

## Tips for a strong password
Use a phrase of several words that you don't use anywhere else. Passwords that appeared in known data leaks are rejected automatically.

## Why it matters
Your RanEddie ID is the key to every RanEddie product — your files in Cloudly, your email in rEmail, your games, purchases and devices. Keeping it accurate and secure protects everything connected to it, and knowing how it works makes it easy to get back in if something goes wrong.

## Best practices
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters — a short phrase works well.
- Turn on two-step verification with an authenticator app.
- Keep your email address up to date so codes and alerts reach you.
- Review active sessions every few months and revoke anything unfamiliar.
- Sign in only at id.raneddie.com.

## Common questions
**Is a RanEddie ID free?**
Yes. Creating and using a RanEddie ID is free. Some products offer paid plans.

**Can I have more than one RanEddie ID?**
Yes, but each needs its own email address and accounts can't be merged later.

**Where do I manage my account?**
In your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).

## Related articles
- [Sign in](/docs/raneddie-id-sign-in) — Sign in to your RanEddie ID on any device.
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password) — Forgot your password? Get back in with a code sent to your email.
- [Security and devices](/docs/raneddie-id-security) — Password, two-step verification and active sessions.

body:

1. Select **Sign in** at the top of raneddie.com, or go to [id.raneddie.com/sign-in](https://id.raneddie.com/sign-in).

title: Get started with Snake Brawl
description: Install the game and play your first round.
body:
## Install
Get Snake Brawl from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snakebrawl.raneddie).

## Play with a friend
Friends mode works for two players on the same local Wi-Fi network. One player hosts and the other joins.

## Save your progress
Connect your RanEddie ID from the game to back up your progress. See [Connect a game](/docs/raneddie-id-connect-game).

## Your first 30 minutes
Work through this checklist to get comfortable with Snake Brawl:
- Try **Showdown**: play a ten-snake battle with no respawns while the poison closes in. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-showdown)
- Try **Endless**: play the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-endless)
- Try **Duo Showdown**: team up with your club's duo partner against four other pairs. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-duo-showdown)
- Try **Brawlers and upgrades**: unlock brawlers and raise their power level. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-brawlers-and-upgrades)
- Try **Snake Pass**: earn rewards across a 30-tier season. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-snake-pass)
- Try **Play with a friend**: play with one friend on the same Wi-Fi network. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-play-with-a-friend)
- Try **Clubs**: join or create a club and play with a duo partner. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-clubs)
- Try **Settings**: adjust sound, controls and graphics. [How to](/docs/snake-brawl-settings)

## Secure your account
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained) for your RanEddie ID.
- Review [Keep your Snake Brawl account secure](/docs/snake-brawl-security).

## Check your privacy settings
Take a minute to review [Snake Brawl and your privacy](/docs/snake-brawl-privacy) and choose what suits you.

## Terms used in Snake Brawl
- **Super** — A powerful attack you charge by hitting other snakes.
- **Power cube** — A pickup from crates and knocked-out snakes that adds 10% health and damage.
- **Poison** — The cloud that closes in during Showdown.
- **Trophies** — Points you earn or lose based on your Showdown rank.
- **Boost** — A sprint that burns length.

## Related articles
- [Snake Brawl overview](/docs/snake-brawl-overview) — Classic Snake meets arena combat. Grow, shoot, charge your Super and be the last snake standing while the poison closes in.
- [Snake Brawl availability and requirements](/docs/snake-brawl-availability-and-requirements) — Where Snake Brawl is available and what you need to use it.
- [Sign in to Snake Brawl with your RanEddie ID](/docs/snake-brawl-sign-in) — Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to Snake Brawl.

title: Fizz Browser availability and requirements
description: Where Fizz Browser is available and what you need to use it.
body:

- Web

## What you need
- A RanEddie ID.
- An internet connection for sign-in, sync and updates.
- The latest version of Fizz Browser and of your device's software.

## Availability
Features and availability can vary by country and region. Some features may arrive in your region later.

## Keeping Fizz Browser up to date
Updates add features, fix problems and keep Fizz Browser secure. Turn on automatic updates wherever your platform offers them.

## Accounts and sign-in
You use Fizz Browser with your RanEddie ID. See [Sign in to Fizz Browser with your RanEddie ID](/docs/fizz-sign-in).

## Accessibility

title: Fizz Browser and your privacy
description: What Fizz Browser stores and how you control it.
body:
## What Fizz Browser stores
Fizz Browser stores your settings, rewards progress and the things you choose to save.

## How it's used
To run Fizz Browser, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Fizz Browser.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Fizz Browser from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Fizz may offer smart suggestions as you type in the search box. Suggestions are optional and can be turned off in settings.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Fizz Browser data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your Fizz Browser data
description: Get a copy of your Fizz Browser data, or remove it.

2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Fizz Browser and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Fizz Browser at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Fizz Browser data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Fizz Browser exports include your settings, rewards progress and the things you choose to save, in common formats you can open with other apps.

- Cancel any Fizz Browser subscriptions.

title: Troubleshooting Fizz Browser
description: Fix common problems with Fizz Browser.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Fizz Browser and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Search results don't open](/docs/fizz-fix-search-results-don-t-open)
- [Rewards progress isn't updating](/docs/fizz-fix-rewards-progress-isn-t-updating)
- [Start page changes disappear](/docs/fizz-fix-start-page-changes-disappear)
- [Sign-in page keeps loading](/docs/fizz-fix-sign-in-page-keeps-loading)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Fizz Browser](/docs/fizz-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Fizz Browser with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Fizz Browser.
- If you're using Fizz Browser in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Fizz Browser completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Fizz Browser and for your device.
3. Sign out of Fizz Browser, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/fizz-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Fizz Browser you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Search from the start page

body:

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Fizz Browser on one of its supported platforms: Web.
- The latest version of Fizz Browser and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Fizz.
2. Select the search box on the start page.
3. Type what you're looking for and press Enter.

## Tip
Typing a full address such as raneddie.com opens the site directly.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Fizz Browser is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- A slow or interrupted connection
- A browser extension or content blocker interfering

The quickest fixes:
1. Check that you're connected to the internet.
2. Turn off content blockers for the page and try again.
3. Reload Fizz.

For the full guide, see [Search results don't open](/docs/fizz-fix-search-results-don-t-open).

title: Snake Brawl overview
description: Classic Snake meets arena combat. Grow, shoot, charge your Super and be the last snake standing while the poison closes in.
body:
Classic Snake meets arena combat. Grow, shoot, charge your Super and be the last snake standing while the poison closes in.

## What's included
- **Arena combat** — Shoot, charge your Super and outplay nine other snakes.
- **12 brawlers** — Every brawler has its own attack, Super and upgrade path.
- **Play with a friend** — Two phones on the same Wi-Fi: Together, Versus, Snake Ball or Egg Heist.
- **Snake Pass** — A 30-tier season with free and Pass+ rewards.

## Where you can use it
- Android

## Next steps
- [Get started with Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-getting-started)
- [Visit the Snake Brawl page](/snake-brawl)

## About Snake Brawl
Snake Brawl takes the game everyone knows and drops it into an arena. Eat orbs to grow, carry a weapon, charge your **Super**, hide in bushes and be the last snake standing while the poison closes in.

## Three ways to play
- **Showdown** — ten snakes, no respawns, and a poison cloud that closes in. Last snake standing wins.
- **Endless** — the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map.
- **Duo Showdown** — team up with your club's duo partner against four other pairs.

## Twelve brawlers
From Viper's venom pellets to Nova's meteor rain, every brawler has its own attack and Super. Unlock new brawlers in the shop and upgrade them from power level 1 to 7.

## Play with a friend
**Friends** mode connects two Android phones on the same Wi-Fi network — choose Together, Versus, Snake Ball or Egg Heist.

## Snake Pass
A 30-tier season pass with free and Snake Pass+ rewards — coins, boxes, skins and brawlers.

## Safe for younger players
Players under 13 get a generated nickname and can't buy coins with real money.

## Popular tasks
- [Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-showdown) — play a ten-snake battle with no respawns while the poison closes in.
- [Endless](/docs/snake-brawl-endless) — play the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map.
- [Duo Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-duo-showdown) — team up with your club's duo partner against four other pairs.
- [Brawlers and upgrades](/docs/snake-brawl-brawlers-and-upgrades) — unlock brawlers and raise their power level.
- [Snake Pass](/docs/snake-brawl-snake-pass) — earn rewards across a 30-tier season.
- [Play with a friend](/docs/snake-brawl-play-with-a-friend) — play with one friend on the same Wi-Fi network.
- [Clubs](/docs/snake-brawl-clubs) — join or create a club and play with a duo partner.
- [Settings](/docs/snake-brawl-settings) — adjust sound, controls and graphics.

## Terms used in Snake Brawl
- **Super** — A powerful attack you charge by hitting other snakes.
- **Power cube** — A pickup from crates and knocked-out snakes that adds 10% health and damage.
- **Poison** — The cloud that closes in during Showdown.
- **Trophies** — Points you earn or lose based on your Showdown rank.
- **Boost** — A sprint that burns length.

## Learn more
- [Snake Brawl FAQ](/docs/snake-brawl-faq)
- [Troubleshooting Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-troubleshooting)
- [Snake Brawl and your privacy](/docs/snake-brawl-privacy)

## Related articles
- [Get started with Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-getting-started) — Install the game and play your first round.
- [Snake Brawl availability and requirements](/docs/snake-brawl-availability-and-requirements) — Where Snake Brawl is available and what you need to use it.
- [Sign in to Snake Brawl with your RanEddie ID](/docs/snake-brawl-sign-in) — Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to Snake Brawl.
- [Snake Brawl and your privacy](/docs/snake-brawl-privacy) — What Snake Brawl stores and how you control it.

title: Sign in to Snake Brawl with your RanEddie ID
description: Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to Snake Brawl.
body:
## Sign in
1. Open Snake Brawl.
2. Choose Sign in.
3. Sign in at id.raneddie.com — you're returned to Snake Brawl automatically.

## On a TV or console
Choose Sign in, then enter the code shown on screen at id.raneddie.com on your phone. See [Sign in on a TV or console](/docs/sign-in-on-a-tv-or-console).

## Trouble signing in?
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password)
- [Why does the sign-in page keep loading?](/docs/sign-in-why-does-the-sign-in-page-keep-loading)

## Signing in on several devices
You can be signed in to Snake Brawl on more than one device at the same time. Each device appears under Active sessions in your Account Center, where you can sign it out remotely.

## Signing out

title: Snake Brawl and your privacy
description: What Snake Brawl stores and how you control it.
body:
## What Snake Brawl stores
Snake Brawl stores your nickname, progress, coins, unlocked brawlers and settings — stored on your phone.

## How it's used
To run Snake Brawl, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Snake Brawl.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Snake Brawl from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Snake Brawl's computer players (bots) adapt to your trophy count: they get smarter, stronger and fancier as you improve.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Snake Brawl data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your Snake Brawl data
description: Get a copy of your Snake Brawl data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Snake Brawl and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Snake Brawl at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Snake Brawl data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Snake Brawl exports include your nickname, progress, coins, unlocked brawlers and settings — stored on your phone, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any Snake Brawl subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

body:
- **Showdown:** The poison starts closing in after 25 seconds — head toward the centre early.
- **Endless:** Boosting burns length — use it to escape or to cut off another snake.

- **Brawlers and upgrades:** Each power level adds 6% health and damage.
- **Snake Pass:** Snake Pass+ costs 1,200 coins — no real money.
- **Play with a friend:** Only two phones can play together: the host and one friend.
- **Clubs:** Some clubs need a minimum number of trophies.
- **Settings:** Low graphics quality can make the game smoother on older phones.

Turn on automatic updates so you always have the latest improvements to Snake Brawl.

title: Troubleshooting Snake Brawl
description: Fix common problems with Snake Brawl.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Snake Brawl and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [I lose trophies even when I do well](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-lose-trophies-even-when-i-do-well)
- [My snake keeps shrinking](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-my-snake-keeps-shrinking)
- [I can't find Duo Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-can-t-find-duo-showdown)
- [I can't afford an upgrade](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-can-t-afford-an-upgrade)
- [A reward turned into coins](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-a-reward-turned-into-coins)
- [My friend can't find my room](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-my-friend-can-t-find-my-room)
- [I can't join a club](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-can-t-join-a-club)
- [The game feels slow](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-the-game-feels-slow)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Snake Brawl with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Snake Brawl.
- If you're using Snake Brawl in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Snake Brawl completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Snake Brawl and for your device.
3. Sign out of Snake Brawl, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/snake-brawl-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Snake Brawl you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Showdown
description: In Snake Brawl: play a ten-snake battle with no respawns while the poison closes in.
body:
With Snake Brawl you can play a ten-snake battle with no respawns while the poison closes in. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Snake Brawl on one of its supported platforms: Android.
- The latest version of Snake Brawl and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Choose Showdown on the main menu.
2. Pick your brawler.
3. Grow, collect power cubes and survive until you're the last snake.

## Tip
The poison starts closing in after 25 seconds — head toward the centre early.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Snake Brawl is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Android) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Trophies depend on your final rank
- Higher trophy counts face stronger bots

The quickest fixes:
1. Focus on surviving longer rather than knockouts.
2. Collect power cubes from crates for +10% health and damage each.
3. Upgrade your favourite brawler.

For the full guide, see [I lose trophies even when I do well](/docs/snake-brawl-fix-i-lose-trophies-even-when-i-do-well).

description: Snake Brawl: why this happens and how to fix it.

- Trophies depend on your final rank

5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/snake-brawl-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Snake Brawl you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Low graphics quality can make the game smoother on older phones.

## About Settings
Snake Brawl lets you adjust sound, controls and graphics. See [Settings](/docs/snake-brawl-settings) for the full how-to.

## More you can do in Snake Brawl
- [Showdown](/docs/snake-brawl-showdown) — play a ten-snake battle with no respawns while the poison closes in.
- [Endless](/docs/snake-brawl-endless) — play the classic grow-as-big-as-you-can mode on a bigger map.

- [Snake Pass](/docs/snake-brawl-snake-pass) — earn rewards across a 30-tier season.
- [Play with a friend](/docs/snake-brawl-play-with-a-friend) — play with one friend on the same Wi-Fi network.

title: BlueBear Media overview
description: BlueBear Media is RanEddie's entertainment company — film, television, streaming, animation, music and theme parks under one roof.
body:
BlueBear Media is RanEddie's entertainment company — film, television, streaming, animation, music and theme parks under one roof.

## What's included
- **BlueBear Pictures** — Feature films from first draft to premiere.
- **BlueBear TV** — Series, live events, kids' programming and channels.
- **BlueBear Stream** — Films and series on every screen, with profiles and downloads.
- **BlueBear Parks & Resorts** — Rides, shows and hotels inspired by BlueBear stories.
- **BlueBear Animation & Music** — Animated films and series, original scores and soundtracks.
- **Studio Tours & Products** — Behind-the-scenes tours, toys, books and collectibles.

## Where you can use it
- Cinemas
- TV
- Streaming
- Parks

## Next steps
- [Get started with BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-get-started)
- [Visit the BlueBear Media page](/bluebear-media)

## About BlueBear Media
BlueBear Media brings RanEddie's storytelling together: the films you see in cinemas, the series you stream at home, the music you hear in them and the parks where you can step inside them.

## BlueBear Pictures
The film studio. BlueBear Pictures develops, produces and releases feature films — from big-screen adventures and family animation to smaller character-driven stories — and takes them from first draft to premiere.

## BlueBear TV
The television group. BlueBear TV produces scripted series, unscripted shows, live events and kids' programming, and runs BlueBear's linear channels.

## BlueBear Stream
The streaming service. Watch BlueBear films and series on phones, tablets, TVs and streamers, with profiles for everyone in the household, downloads for offline viewing and a kids' space with its own controls.

## BlueBear Animation
Feature films, series and shorts made by BlueBear's animation studio, for young audiences and grown-ups alike.

## BlueBear Music
Original scores and soundtracks, plus a label for artists whose music starts on screen and keeps going.

## BlueBear Parks & Resorts
Theme parks, water parks and resort hotels where BlueBear stories become rides, shows, food and places to stay.

## BlueBear Studio Tours
Walk the backlots and sound stages, see how scenes are built and visit the departments that make them.

## BlueBear Consumer Products
Toys, apparel, books and collectibles inspired by BlueBear films and series.

## Made with RanEddie tools
BlueBear productions use EditTime for editing and post-production, Cloudly for storage and delivery, and RanEddie ID for one account across BlueBear Stream, park tickets and the BlueBear shop.

## Popular tasks
- [BlueBear Stream profiles](/docs/bluebear-media-bluebear-stream-profiles) — give everyone in your household their own profile with its own recommendations and watch list.
- [Downloads](/docs/bluebear-media-downloads) — download films and episodes to watch without a connection.
- [Watch on your TV](/docs/bluebear-media-watch-on-your-tv) — watch BlueBear Stream on a TV, streamer or Lu Stream.
- [Parental controls](/docs/bluebear-media-parental-controls) — control what younger viewers can watch.
- [Park tickets](/docs/bluebear-media-park-tickets) — buy and store BlueBear Parks & Resorts tickets in your RanEddie ID.
- [Resort reservations](/docs/bluebear-media-resort-reservations) — book a room at a BlueBear resort hotel.
- [Studio Tours](/docs/bluebear-media-studio-tours) — book a guided tour of BlueBear's backlots and sound stages.
- [BlueBear Shop](/docs/bluebear-media-bluebear-shop) — buy toys, apparel, books and collectibles.

## Terms used in BlueBear Media
- **Profile** — A personal space in BlueBear Stream with its own recommendations.
- **Maturity level** — The age rating a profile is allowed to watch.
- **Backlot** — Outdoor sets at a film studio.
- **Download** — A copy of a title stored on your device for offline viewing.

## Learn more
- [BlueBear Media FAQ](/docs/bluebear-media-faq)
- [Troubleshooting BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-troubleshooting)
- [BlueBear Media and your privacy](/docs/bluebear-media-privacy)

## Sign in
1. Open BlueBear Media.
2. Choose Sign in.

## On a TV or console
Choose Sign in, then enter the code shown on screen at id.raneddie.com on your phone. See [Sign in on a TV or console](/docs/sign-in-on-a-tv-or-console).

title: BlueBear Media and your privacy
description: What BlueBear Media stores and how you control it.
body:
## What BlueBear Media stores
BlueBear Media stores your BlueBear Stream profiles, watch history, downloads, park tickets and shop orders.

## How it's used
To run BlueBear Media, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside BlueBear Media.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage BlueBear Media from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
BlueBear Stream can recommend films and series based on what each profile watches. Recommendations stay inside each profile and can be reset at any time.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your BlueBear Media data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

## Related articles

title: Download or delete your BlueBear Media data
description: Get a copy of your BlueBear Media data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose BlueBear Media and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside BlueBear Media at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your BlueBear Media data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
BlueBear Media exports include your BlueBear Stream profiles, watch history, downloads, park tickets and shop orders, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any BlueBear Media subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your BlueBear Media account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects BlueBear Media too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep BlueBear Media updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

## Signs something may be wrong
- Sign-in alerts you don't recognise.
- Changes to your BlueBear Media settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

title: Troubleshooting BlueBear Media
description: Fix common problems with BlueBear Media.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update BlueBear Media and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Recommendations don't match what I watch](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-recommendations-don-t-match-what-i-watch)
- [A download expired](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-a-download-expired)
- [Video keeps buffering](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-video-keeps-buffering)
- [A kids' profile shows the wrong titles](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-a-kids-profile-shows-the-wrong-titles)
- [My ticket won't scan](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-my-ticket-won-t-scan)
- [I can't change my reservation](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-i-can-t-change-my-reservation)
- [My tour time changed](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-my-tour-time-changed)
- [My order hasn't arrived](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-my-order-hasn-t-arrived)

## Still need help?
[Get help with BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to BlueBear Media with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to BlueBear Media.
- If you're using BlueBear Media in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart BlueBear Media completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for BlueBear Media and for your device.
3. Sign out of BlueBear Media, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/bluebear-media-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of BlueBear Media you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: BlueBear Stream profiles
description: In BlueBear Media: give everyone in your household their own profile with its own recommendations and watch list.
body:
With BlueBear Media you can give everyone in your household their own profile with its own recommendations and watch list. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- BlueBear Media on one of its supported platforms: Cinemas, TV, Streaming, Parks.
- The latest version of BlueBear Media and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open BlueBear Stream and sign in with your RanEddie ID.
2. Choose Manage profiles.
3. Add a profile, pick an avatar and set the maturity level.

## Tip
Create a kids' profile for younger viewers — it only shows titles for their age.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where BlueBear Media is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Cinemas, TV, Streaming, Parks) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Someone else watched on your profile
- Your watch history is mixed between people

The quickest fixes:
1. Give each person their own profile.
2. Remove titles from your watch history.
3. Reset recommendations in profile settings.

For the full guide, see [Recommendations don't match what I watch](/docs/bluebear-media-fix-recommendations-don-t-match-what-i-watch).

## Privacy and security
BlueBear Media stores your BlueBear Stream profiles, watch history, downloads, park tickets and shop orders. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your BlueBear Media data too.

title: Lu overview
description: Lu is RanEddie's family of devices — phone, tablet, watch, earbuds, streamer, laptop and home speaker — designed to work as one.
body:
Lu is RanEddie's family of devices — phone, tablet, watch, earbuds, streamer, laptop and home speaker — designed to work as one.

## What's included
- **Lu Phone & Lu Tab** — Bright displays, all-day battery and Lu OS on every screen.
- **Lu Watch** — Calls, health tracking, workouts and payments on your wrist.
- **Lu Buds** — Noise cancellation and automatic switching between devices.
- **Lu Stream & Lu Home** — A smarter TV and room-filling sound for the whole home.
- **Lu Book** — A laptop with workIT built in and Lu Link to your phone.
- **Lu Link** — Copy, paste, hand off calls and find devices across Lu.

## Where you can use it
- Lu Phone
- Lu Tab
- Lu Watch
- Lu Buds
- Lu Stream
- Lu Book
- Lu Home

## Next steps
- [Get started with Lu](/docs/lu-get-started)
- [Visit the Lu page](/lu)

## About Lu
Lu is a family of devices that know about each other. Start something on your phone and finish it on your tablet, answer a call on your watch, and move music from your earbuds to the speaker in the kitchen — all with one RanEddie ID.

## Lu Phone
The centre of Lu: a bright display, an all-day battery, a camera system tuned for real life, and Lu OS keeping your apps, photos and messages in sync.

## Lu Tab
A thin, light tablet for watching, drawing, reading and working — with keyboard and pen accessories when you need them.

## Lu Watch
Notifications, calls, workouts, heart-rate and sleep tracking, and payments from your wrist.

## Lu Buds
Wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation, a transparency mode and automatic switching between your Lu devices.

## Lu Stream
A small box that turns any TV into a smart TV, with BlueBear Stream, RanEddie Games streaming and your Lu photos on the big screen.

## Lu Book
A laptop for work and study, with workIT built in and Lu Link to your phone.

## Lu Home
A home speaker with room-filling sound that controls your smart home and plays across rooms.

## Lu Link
Lu Link connects your devices: copy on one and paste on another, hand off a call, share Wi-Fi passwords, unlock your Lu Book with your Lu Watch and find any device that goes missing.

## Built to last
Lu devices get software updates for years, and RanEddie Part offers genuine parts, repairs and trade-in when you're ready for something new.

## Popular tasks
- [Set up a new Lu device](/docs/lu-set-up-a-new-lu-device) — set up a Lu device and sign in with your RanEddie ID.
- [Lu Link](/docs/lu-lu-link) — copy, paste and hand off between your Lu devices.
- [Pair Lu Buds](/docs/lu-pair-lu-buds) — connect Lu Buds to your phone and other Lu devices.
- [Health on Lu Watch](/docs/lu-health-on-lu-watch) — track workouts, heart rate and sleep.
- [Find my device](/docs/lu-find-my-device) — locate, ring or lock a missing Lu device.
- [Back up to Cloudly](/docs/lu-back-up-to-cloudly) — keep a copy of your device in Cloudly.
- [Software updates](/docs/lu-software-updates) — keep Lu OS up to date.
- [Lu Stream setup](/docs/lu-lu-stream-setup) — connect Lu Stream to your TV.

## Terms used in Lu
- **Lu OS** — The software that runs on Lu devices.
- **Lu Link** — Features that connect your Lu devices together.
- **Hand-off** — Moving an activity from one device to another.
- **ANC** — Active noise cancellation in Lu Buds.

## Learn more
- [Lu FAQ](/docs/lu-faq)
- [Troubleshooting Lu](/docs/lu-troubleshooting)
- [Lu and your privacy](/docs/lu-privacy)

## Related articles
- [Get started with Lu](/docs/lu-get-started) — Everything you need for your first day with Lu.
- [Lu availability and requirements](/docs/lu-availability-and-requirements) — Where Lu is available and what you need to use it.
- [Sign in to Lu with your RanEddie ID](/docs/lu-sign-in) — Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to Lu.

title: Lu and your privacy

body:
## What Lu stores
Lu stores device backups, health and fitness data, photos, Wi-Fi passwords and the list of devices linked to your RanEddie ID.

## How it's used
To run Lu, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Lu.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Lu from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Lu OS uses on-device intelligence for features like photo search, smart replies and battery optimisation. Where possible, this processing happens on the device itself.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Lu data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your Lu data

body:

1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Lu and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Lu at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Lu data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Lu exports include device backups, health and fitness data, photos, Wi-Fi passwords and the list of devices linked to your RanEddie ID, in common formats you can open with other apps.

title: Keep your Lu account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your Lu account.
body:

Your Lu account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects Lu too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).

- Changes to your Lu settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

title: Troubleshooting Lu
description: Fix common problems with Lu.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Lu and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Setup is stuck on Wi-Fi](/docs/lu-fix-setup-is-stuck-on-wi-fi)
- [Copy and paste doesn't move between devices](/docs/lu-fix-copy-and-paste-doesn-t-move-between-devices)
- [One earbud has no sound](/docs/lu-fix-one-earbud-has-no-sound)
- [Heart-rate readings look wrong](/docs/lu-fix-heart-rate-readings-look-wrong)
- [My device shows as offline](/docs/lu-fix-my-device-shows-as-offline)
- [Backup didn't finish](/docs/lu-fix-backup-didn-t-finish)
- [An update won't install](/docs/lu-fix-an-update-won-t-install)
- [No picture on the TV](/docs/lu-fix-no-picture-on-the-tv)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Lu](/docs/lu-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Lu with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Lu.
- If you're using Lu in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Lu completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Lu and for your device.
3. Sign out of Lu, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/lu-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Lu you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

body:
With Lu you can set up a Lu device and sign in with your RanEddie ID. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Lu on one of its supported platforms: Lu Phone, Lu Tab, Lu Watch, Lu Buds, Lu Stream, Lu Book, Lu Home.
- The latest version of Lu and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.

1. Turn on the device and choose your language.
2. Connect to Wi-Fi.
3. Sign in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restore from a Cloudly backup or set up as new.

Hold another Lu device nearby to copy settings automatically.

- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Lu is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Lu Phone, Lu Tab, Lu Watch, Lu Buds, Lu Stream, Lu Book, Lu Home) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

- Wrong Wi-Fi password
- A network that needs a sign-in page

2. Turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

- Devices signed in with different RanEddie IDs
- Bluetooth is off on one device

The quickest fixes:

2. Turn Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on.
3. Turn Lu Link off and on again.

RanEddie Part is where RanEddie hardware gets a longer life — genuine parts, repairs, accessories, protection plans, trade-in and recycling.

## What's included
- **Genuine parts** — Batteries, screens, cameras and ports matched to your device.
- **Repair centres & mail-in** — Book a visit or send your device in.
- **Self-repair kits** — The part, the tools and a guide for your exact model.
- **Part Care** — Accidental damage cover and express replacements.
- **Trade-in & recycling** — Credit for your old device, or free recycling.
- **Certified refurbished** — Like-new devices with a full warranty.

## Where you can use it
- Repair centres
- Mail-in
- Online store

## Next steps
- [Get started with RanEddie Part](/docs/raneddie-part-get-started)
- [Visit the RanEddie Part page](/raneddie-part)

## About RanEddie Part
Every Lu device, RanEddie Core console and Gimbly camera is built to be repaired. RanEddie Part is the home for everything that keeps them going.

## Genuine parts
Batteries, screens, cameras, charging ports, controllers and more — the same parts used in RanEddie repair centres, each matched to your device's serial number.

## Repairs your way
Book a repair at a RanEddie Part centre, send your device by mail, or fix it yourself with a self-repair kit and step-by-step guides.

## Self-repair kits
Kits include the part, the right tools and a guide written for your exact model. Return the old part in the prepaid box and it's recycled.

## Part Care
Protection plans that cover accidental damage, battery service and express replacements for Lu devices, RanEddie Core and Gimbly.

## Accessories
Cases, chargers, cables, bands, controllers and docks designed for RanEddie hardware.

## Trade-in and recycling
Trade in your old device for credit, or recycle it for free. Every device is checked, wiped securely and either refurbished or recycled responsibly.

## Certified refurbished
Refurbished RanEddie devices with a new battery, genuine parts and a full warranty.

## Popular tasks
- [Book a repair](/docs/raneddie-part-book-a-repair) — book a repair at a RanEddie Part centre.
- [Mail-in repair](/docs/raneddie-part-mail-in-repair) — send your device to RanEddie Part by post.

- [Trade in a device](/docs/raneddie-part-trade-in-a-device) — get credit for a device you no longer use.
- [Recycle a device](/docs/raneddie-part-recycle-a-device) — recycle RanEddie hardware for free.
- [Check your warranty](/docs/raneddie-part-check-your-warranty) — see your device's warranty and Part Care status.
- [Buy accessories](/docs/raneddie-part-buy-accessories) — find cases, chargers and accessories for your devices.

## Terms used in RanEddie Part
- **Serial number** — The unique code that identifies your device.
- **Part Care** — A RanEddie Part protection plan.
- **Refurbished** — A pre-owned device restored with genuine parts.

## Learn more

- [Troubleshooting RanEddie Part](/docs/raneddie-part-troubleshooting)
- [RanEddie Part and your privacy](/docs/raneddie-part-privacy)

body:
## Sign in
1. Open RanEddie Part.
2. Choose Sign in.
3. Sign in at id.raneddie.com — you're returned to RanEddie Part automatically.

## On a TV or console
Choose Sign in, then enter the code shown on screen at id.raneddie.com on your phone. See [Sign in on a TV or console](/docs/sign-in-on-a-tv-or-console).

## Trouble signing in?
- [Reset your password](/docs/raneddie-id-reset-password)
- [Why does the sign-in page keep loading?](/docs/sign-in-why-does-the-sign-in-page-keep-loading)

## Signing in on several devices
You can be signed in to RanEddie Part on more than one device at the same time. Each device appears under Active sessions in your Account Center, where you can sign it out remotely.

## Signing out
Choose Sign out from RanEddie Part's account menu. To sign out everywhere at once, revoke your sessions from the Security page of your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).

## Keep sign-in safe
- Sign in only at id.raneddie.com.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- RanEddie will never ask for your password or verification codes.

## Privacy and security
RanEddie Part stores your device serial numbers, repair history, orders and Part Care plans. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Part data too.

- [RanEddie Part and your privacy](/docs/raneddie-part-privacy)
- [Keep your RanEddie Part account secure](/docs/raneddie-part-security)

title: RanEddie Part and your privacy
description: What RanEddie Part stores and how you control it.
body:
## What RanEddie Part stores
RanEddie Part stores your device serial numbers, repair history, orders and Part Care plans.

## How it's used
To run RanEddie Part, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside RanEddie Part.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage RanEddie Part from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
RanEddie Part's diagnostics can suggest which part is likely at fault from a device's self-test results. A technician always confirms before any repair.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your RanEddie Part data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your RanEddie Part data
description: Get a copy of your RanEddie Part data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose RanEddie Part and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside RanEddie Part at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your RanEddie Part data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
RanEddie Part exports include your device serial numbers, repair history, orders and Part Care plans, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any RanEddie Part subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Keep your RanEddie Part account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your RanEddie Part account.
body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your RanEddie Part account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects RanEddie Part too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep RanEddie Part updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

## Signs something may be wrong
- Sign-in alerts you don't recognise.
- Changes to your RanEddie Part settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

## Privacy and security
RanEddie Part stores your device serial numbers, repair history, orders and Part Care plans. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Part data too.

title: Accessibility in RanEddie Part
description: Features that make RanEddie Part easier to use.
body:
## Built in
- Support for screen readers on supported platforms
- Keyboard navigation where a keyboard is available
- Respect for your device's text size, dark mode and reduced motion settings
- Captions wherever RanEddie Part plays video

## Feedback
Something hard to use? [Report an accessibility problem](/docs/accessibility-report-an-accessibility-problem).

## On each platform
- **Repair centres** — RanEddie Part follows the accessibility settings of Repair centres, including text size, contrast, screen reader and reduce motion where available.
- **Mail-in** — RanEddie Part follows the accessibility settings of Mail-in, including text size, contrast, screen reader and reduce motion where available.
- **Online store** — RanEddie Part follows the accessibility settings of Online store, including text size, contrast, screen reader and reduce motion where available.

## Tips
- Increase text size in your device settings — RanEddie Part follows it.
- Turn on dark mode for comfortable viewing in low light.
- Turn on reduce motion to minimise animations.

body:

- **Part Care:** Part Care includes battery service when capacity drops below 80%.
- **Trade in a device:** Sign out of your RanEddie ID and erase the device before trading it in.

- **Check your warranty:** Keep your proof of purchase in your RanEddie ID.

title: RanEddie Part glossary
description: Terms you'll see in RanEddie Part.
body:
- **Serial number** — The unique code that identifies your device.
- **Part Care** — A RanEddie Part protection plan.
- **Refurbished** — A pre-owned device restored with genuine parts.
- **RanEddie ID** — the account you use across every RanEddie product.

## General RanEddie terms
- **RanEddie ID** — the one account you use across every RanEddie product.
- **Account Center** — where you manage your RanEddie ID at id.raneddie.com/account.
- **Two-step verification** — a second check, like an authenticator code, after your password.
- **Session** — a device or browser where you're signed in.
- **Cloudly** — RanEddie's cloud, where your files and backups live.
- **Family group** — up to six people who share plans and family settings.

## About RanEddie Part
RanEddie Part is where RanEddie hardware gets a longer life — genuine parts, repairs, accessories, protection plans, trade-in and recycling. See the [RanEddie Part overview](/docs/raneddie-part-overview) to learn more.

title: Troubleshooting RanEddie Part
description: Fix common problems with RanEddie Part.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update RanEddie Part and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [No appointments are available](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-no-appointments-are-available)
- [My repair is taking longer than expected](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-my-repair-is-taking-longer-than-expected)
- [The new part isn't recognised](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-the-new-part-isn-t-recognised)
- [My claim was declined](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-my-claim-was-declined)
- [My trade-in value changed](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-my-trade-in-value-changed)
- [I can't print a label](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-i-can-t-print-a-label)
- [My device isn't listed](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-my-device-isn-t-listed)
- [The accessory doesn't fit](/docs/raneddie-part-fix-the-accessory-doesn-t-fit)

## Still need help?
[Get help with RanEddie Part](/docs/raneddie-part-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to RanEddie Part with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to RanEddie Part.
- If you're using RanEddie Part in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Part completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Part and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Part, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-part-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Part you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Book a repair
description: In RanEddie Part: book a repair at a RanEddie Part centre.
body:
With RanEddie Part you can book a repair at a RanEddie Part centre. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

- The device's condition differed from the description

2. Check your model name in Settings > About.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Part completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Part and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Part, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-part-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Part you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Filter by device so you only see accessories that fit.

## About Buy accessories
RanEddie Part lets you find cases, chargers and accessories for your devices. See [Buy accessories](/docs/raneddie-part-buy-accessories) for the full how-to.

description: SkyPear is a fast-food restaurant chain known for its signature pizzas on crispy tortilla or fresh dough, hot dogs, loaded fries, wraps, shakes and more.
body:
SkyPear is a fast-food restaurant chain known for its signature pizzas on crispy tortilla or fresh dough, hot dogs, loaded fries, wraps, shakes and more.

## What's included
- **Tortilla & dough pizzas** — A crisp tortilla base or fresh dough baked daily.
- **Hot dogs** — Grilled, loaded and served with SkyPear sauces.
- **Fries, wraps & shakes** — A full menu around the pizza.
- **Order ahead** — Skip the queue with the SkyPear app.
- **Delivery** — From many SkyPear restaurants to your door.
- **Pear Points** — Earn points on every order and get free food.

## Where you can use it
- Restaurants
- SkyPear app
- Delivery

## Next steps
- [Get started with SkyPear](/docs/skypear-get-started)
- [Visit the SkyPear page](/skypear)

## About SkyPear
SkyPear started with one question: what if the base were the best part of the pizza? Today SkyPear restaurants serve pizzas on two very different foundations — and a full menu around them.

## Two kinds of pizza
- **Tortilla pizzas** — a thin, crisp tortilla base that bakes in minutes, with toppings piled edge to edge.
- **Dough pizzas** — fresh dough, proofed in the restaurant every day and baked until the crust is golden and airy.

Every pizza comes in classic and SkyPear originals, and you can build your own from the topping bar.

## Hot dogs
Grilled hot dogs in toasted buns with SkyPear's own sauces and crunchy toppings — plus vegetarian sausages.

## Beyond pizza
Loaded fries, wraps, salads, wings, shakes, fresh juices and desserts — including the Pear Crumble the brand is named after.

## Order your way
Eat in, take away, drive through, or order ahead in the SkyPear app and skip the queue. Delivery is available from many restaurants.

## Pear Points
Earn Pear Points with every order in the app and swap them for free food.

## Know what you eat
Allergen and nutrition information for every item is in the app and in every restaurant. Ask the team if you have an allergy — they'll help you choose.

## Popular tasks
- [Order ahead](/docs/skypear-order-ahead) — order in the SkyPear app and collect without queuing.
- [Delivery](/docs/skypear-delivery) — get SkyPear delivered.
- [Build your own pizza](/docs/skypear-build-your-own-pizza) — choose a base and toppings.
- [Pear Points](/docs/skypear-pear-points) — earn and spend Pear Points.
- [Allergens and nutrition](/docs/skypear-allergens-and-nutrition) — find allergen and nutrition information.
- [Group orders](/docs/skypear-group-orders) — order together with friends or colleagues.
- [Catering](/docs/skypear-catering) — order SkyPear for events.
- [Refunds](/docs/skypear-refunds) — get help with an order that wasn't right.

## Terms used in SkyPear
- **Tortilla pizza** — SkyPear's signature pizza on a thin, crisp tortilla base.
- **Pear Points** — SkyPear's rewards points.
- **Order ahead** — Ordering in the app and collecting without queuing.

## Learn more

- [Troubleshooting SkyPear](/docs/skypear-troubleshooting)
- [SkyPear and your privacy](/docs/skypear-privacy)

title: SkyPear and your privacy
description: What SkyPear stores and how you control it.
body:
## What SkyPear stores
SkyPear stores your orders, saved addresses, favourite restaurants, Pear Points and dietary preferences.

## How it's used
To run SkyPear, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside SkyPear.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage SkyPear from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
The SkyPear app can suggest favourites and combos based on your past orders. You can clear your order history at any time.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your SkyPear data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your SkyPear data
description: Get a copy of your SkyPear data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose SkyPear and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside SkyPear at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your SkyPear data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
SkyPear exports include your orders, saved addresses, favourite restaurants, Pear Points and dietary preferences, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any SkyPear subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Keep your SkyPear account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your SkyPear account.
body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your SkyPear account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects SkyPear too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep SkyPear updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

## Signs something may be wrong
- Sign-in alerts you don't recognise.
- Changes to your SkyPear settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

SkyPear stores your orders, saved addresses, favourite restaurants, Pear Points and dietary preferences. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your SkyPear data too.

title: Troubleshooting SkyPear
description: Fix common problems with SkyPear.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update SkyPear and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [My order isn't ready at the pickup time](/docs/skypear-fix-my-order-isn-t-ready-at-the-pickup-time)
- [My delivery is late or missing](/docs/skypear-fix-my-delivery-is-late-or-missing)
- [A topping I want isn't listed](/docs/skypear-fix-a-topping-i-want-isn-t-listed)
- [Points are missing from an order](/docs/skypear-fix-points-are-missing-from-an-order)
- [I can't find allergen information](/docs/skypear-fix-i-can-t-find-allergen-information)
- [Someone can't join the group order](/docs/skypear-fix-someone-can-t-join-the-group-order)
- [My catering date isn't available](/docs/skypear-fix-my-catering-date-isn-t-available)
- [I didn't get my refund](/docs/skypear-fix-i-didn-t-get-my-refund)

## Still need help?
[Get help with SkyPear](/docs/skypear-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to SkyPear with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to SkyPear.
- If you're using SkyPear in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart SkyPear completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for SkyPear and for your device.
3. Sign out of SkyPear, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/skypear-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of SkyPear you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Order ahead
description: In SkyPear: order in the SkyPear app and collect without queuing.
body:
With SkyPear you can order in the SkyPear app and collect without queuing. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- SkyPear on one of its supported platforms: Restaurants, SkyPear app, Delivery.
- The latest version of SkyPear and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open the SkyPear app and choose a restaurant.
2. Add items and choose a pickup time.
3. Pay and collect from the pickup shelf.

## Tip
Turn on notifications to know the moment your order is ready.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where SkyPear is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Restaurants, SkyPear app, Delivery) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- A busy period at the restaurant

The quickest fixes:
1. Show your order number to the team.
2. Check the order status in the app.

For the full guide, see [My order isn't ready at the pickup time](/docs/skypear-fix-my-order-isn-t-ready-at-the-pickup-time).

## Privacy and security
SkyPear stores your orders, saved addresses, favourite restaurants, Pear Points and dietary preferences. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your SkyPear data too.

- [SkyPear and your privacy](/docs/skypear-privacy)

title: I didn't get my refund
description: SkyPear: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Refunds** in SkyPear and this happens: *i didn't get my refund*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to SkyPear with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to SkyPear.
- If you're using SkyPear in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- Refunds take a few days to reach your bank

## How to fix it
1. Allow 3–5 business days.
2. Contact support with your order number.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart SkyPear completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for SkyPear and for your device.
3. Sign out of SkyPear, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/skypear-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of SkyPear you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Report problems within 24 hours of your order.

## About Refunds
SkyPear lets you get help with an order that wasn't right. See [Refunds](/docs/skypear-refunds) for the full how-to.

body:
workIT is RanEddie's productivity suite — documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, forms and meetings that work together, with workIT Assist built in.

## What's included
- **Write, Sheets & Slides** — Documents, spreadsheets and presentations that work together.
- **Notes & Forms** — Notebooks, surveys and quizzes with live responses.
- **workIT Meet** — Video meetings with recordings and transcripts.
- **workIT Assist** — An AI assistant in every app.
- **Real-time collaboration** — Edit together, comment and track changes.
- **Saved to Cloudly** — Every change saved automatically and available everywhere.

## Where you can use it
- Web
- Windows
- macOS
- Lu Book
- Lu Tab
- Phones

## Next steps
- [Get started with workIT](/docs/workit-get-started)
- [Visit the workIT page](/workit)

## About workIT
workIT brings together the apps you use to write, calculate, present and meet — on the web, on your computer and on your phone — with files saved to Cloudly and shared in a click.

## workIT Write
A word processor for everything from a one-page letter to a 300-page report: styles, tables, comments, suggestions, version history and export to common formats.

## workIT Sheets
Spreadsheets with formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters and live collaboration — from a household budget to a company forecast.

## workIT Slides
Presentations with themes, animations, presenter view and live captions when you present.

## workIT Notes
Notebooks for ideas, meeting notes and to-dos, with handwriting on Lu Tab.

## workIT Forms
Surveys, quizzes and sign-up forms with responses collected straight into workIT Sheets.

## workIT Meet
Video meetings with screen sharing, chat, recordings and transcripts.

## workIT Assist
An AI assistant inside every workIT app. Ask it to draft a document, summarise a long thread, build a formula, turn notes into slides or recap a meeting — and review what it suggests before you use it.

## Work together
Share a file with a link, edit at the same time, leave comments and see who changed what. Everything saves automatically to Cloudly.

## Popular tasks
- [Create a document in workIT Write](/docs/workit-create-a-document-in-workit-write) — start a new document from scratch or a template.
- [Formulas in workIT Sheets](/docs/workit-formulas-in-workit-sheets) — calculate with formulas and functions.
- [Present with workIT Slides](/docs/workit-present-with-workit-slides) — present a slideshow with speaker notes.
- [Share and collaborate](/docs/workit-share-and-collaborate) — share files and work on them together.
- [workIT Assist](/docs/workit-workit-assist) — use the AI assistant to draft, summarise and analyse.
- [workIT Meet](/docs/workit-workit-meet) — host and join video meetings.
- [workIT Forms](/docs/workit-workit-forms) — build a survey or quiz and collect responses.
- [Version history](/docs/workit-version-history) — see and restore earlier versions of a file.

## Terms used in workIT
- **Template** — A ready-made starting point for a document.
- **Formula** — A calculation in a spreadsheet cell.
- **Presenter view** — A screen with notes and a timer while you present.
- **workIT Assist** — The AI assistant built into workIT.

## Learn more
- [workIT FAQ](/docs/workit-faq)
- [Troubleshooting workIT](/docs/workit-troubleshooting)
- [workIT and your privacy](/docs/workit-privacy)
