title: workIT and your privacy
description: What workIT stores and how you control it.
body:
## What workIT stores
workIT stores your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, form responses and meeting recordings, stored in Cloudly.

## How it's used
To run workIT, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside workIT.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage workIT from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
workIT Assist uses AI to draft, summarise and analyse content you ask it about. It works on the files you choose, and you review its suggestions before they're added to your work.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your workIT data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your workIT data
description: Get a copy of your workIT data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose workIT and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside workIT at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your workIT data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
workIT exports include your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, form responses and meeting recordings, stored in Cloudly, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any workIT subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your workIT account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects workIT too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep workIT updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

## Signs something may be wrong
- Sign-in alerts you don't recognise.
- Changes to your workIT settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

workIT stores your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, form responses and meeting recordings, stored in Cloudly. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your workIT data too.

title: Troubleshooting workIT
description: Fix common problems with workIT.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update workIT and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [My document won't save](/docs/workit-fix-my-document-won-t-save)
- [A formula shows an error](/docs/workit-fix-a-formula-shows-an-error)
- [The audience sees my notes](/docs/workit-fix-the-audience-sees-my-notes)
- [Someone can't open my file](/docs/workit-fix-someone-can-t-open-my-file)
- [Assist gives an inaccurate answer](/docs/workit-fix-assist-gives-an-inaccurate-answer)
- [Others can't hear me](/docs/workit-fix-others-can-t-hear-me)
- [I'm not getting responses](/docs/workit-fix-i-m-not-getting-responses)
- [I deleted content by mistake](/docs/workit-fix-i-deleted-content-by-mistake)

## Still need help?
[Get help with workIT](/docs/workit-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to workIT with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to workIT.
- If you're using workIT in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart workIT completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for workIT and for your device.
3. Sign out of workIT, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/workit-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of workIT you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Create a document in workIT Write
description: In workIT: start a new document from scratch or a template.
body:
With workIT you can start a new document from scratch or a template. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- workIT on one of its supported platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab, Phones.
- The latest version of workIT and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open workIT and choose Write.
2. Select Blank document or pick a template.
3. Give it a name — it saves to Cloudly automatically.

## Tip
Use heading styles so you get an automatic table of contents.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where workIT is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web, Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab, Phones) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- You're offline
- Your Cloudly storage is full

The quickest fixes:
1. Check your connection — changes save when you reconnect.
2. Free up Cloudly storage.

For the full guide, see [My document won't save](/docs/workit-fix-my-document-won-t-save).

## Privacy and security
workIT stores your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, form responses and meeting recordings, stored in Cloudly. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your workIT data too.

description: In workIT: calculate with formulas and functions.

1. Select a cell and type =.
2. Start typing a function such as SUM, AVERAGE or LOOKUP.

## Tip

- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where workIT is available.

- A reference points to an empty or text cell

title: Version history
description: In workIT: see and restore earlier versions of a file.
body:
With workIT you can see and restore earlier versions of a file. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- workIT on one of its supported platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab, Phones.
- The latest version of workIT and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open the file.
2. Select File > Version history.
3. Choose a version and select Restore.

## Tip
Name important versions so they're easy to find later.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where workIT is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web, Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab, Phones) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- The change was saved automatically

The quickest fixes:
1. Open version history and restore the version from before the change.

For the full guide, see [I deleted content by mistake](/docs/workit-fix-i-deleted-content-by-mistake).

## Privacy and security
workIT stores your documents, spreadsheets, presentations, notes, form responses and meeting recordings, stored in Cloudly. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your workIT data too.

title: EditTime overview
description: EditTime is a complete video editor with AI built into every step — from first assembly to final colour, sound and delivery — built for professional film and television productions and creators alike.
body:
EditTime is a complete video editor with AI built into every step — from first assembly to final colour, sound and delivery — built for professional film and television productions and creators alike.

## What's included
- **Professional timeline** — Multicam, nested sequences and keyboard-driven editing.
- **AI editing tools** — Scene detection, transcript editing, smart reframe and rough cuts.
- **Colour & sound** — Node-based grading, HDR scopes and broadcast-ready mixing.
- **Effects & titles** — Keying, tracking, stabilisation and motion graphics.
- **Team collaboration** — Shared projects in Cloudly with review links.
- **Deliver anywhere** — Presets for cinema, broadcast, streaming and social.

## Where you can use it
- Windows
- macOS
- Lu Book
- Lu Tab

## Next steps
- [Get started with EditTime](/docs/edittime-get-started)
- [Visit the EditTime page](/edittime)

## About EditTime
EditTime is a full post-production studio in one app: edit, colour, sound, effects and delivery on a single timeline, with AI that takes on the repetitive work so editors can focus on the story.

## A timeline built for long-form work
Multi-track editing, multicam, nested sequences, trimming tools and keyboard-driven workflows that hold up across feature-length projects.

## AI that edits with you
- **Scene detection** finds every cut in existing footage.
- **Transcript editing** lets you cut interviews by editing the words.
- **Smart reframe** keeps the subject centred when you change aspect ratio.
- **Auto-captions** in many languages, ready to style.
- **Voice cleanup** removes background noise and room echo.
- **Rough cut assistant** builds a first assembly from your script and selects.

## Colour
Node-based grading, HDR scopes, LUT support and AI shot matching so every angle looks like it belongs.

## Sound
Mixing, effects and loudness meters to match broadcast and streaming delivery specs.

## Effects and titles
Keying, tracking, stabilisation, motion graphics and titles without leaving the timeline.

## Collaboration at production scale
Projects live in Cloudly, so editors, assistants, colourists and producers can work on the same project with locking, comments and review links.

## Proxy and camera workflows
Work smoothly with high-resolution camera formats through automatic proxies, then relink to originals for delivery.

## Deliver anywhere
Export presets for cinema, broadcast, streaming platforms and social — or send straight to BlueBear Stream review.

## Popular tasks
- [Create a project](/docs/edittime-create-a-project) — start a project and import media.
- [Transcript editing](/docs/edittime-transcript-editing) — edit interviews by editing the text.
- [Scene detection](/docs/edittime-scene-detection) — split existing footage at every cut.
- [Auto-captions](/docs/edittime-auto-captions) — create captions automatically.
- [Colour grading](/docs/edittime-colour-grading) — correct and grade colour.
- [Proxy workflows](/docs/edittime-proxy-workflows) — edit high-resolution footage smoothly.
- [Collaborate on a project](/docs/edittime-collaborate-on-a-project) — work on the same project with your team.
- [Export and delivery](/docs/edittime-export-and-delivery) — export for any destination.

## Terms used in EditTime
- **Proxy** — A lightweight copy of footage used for smooth editing.
- **Multicam** — Editing several camera angles shot at the same time.
- **LUT** — A lookup table that transforms colour.
- **Picture lock** — The point when the edit is final.
- **Nested sequence** — A sequence placed inside another sequence.

## Learn more
- [EditTime FAQ](/docs/edittime-faq)
- [Troubleshooting EditTime](/docs/edittime-troubleshooting)
- [EditTime and your privacy](/docs/edittime-privacy)

## Related articles

- [EditTime availability and requirements](/docs/edittime-availability-and-requirements) — Where EditTime is available and what you need to use it.

title: EditTime and your privacy
description: What EditTime stores and how you control it.
body:
## What EditTime stores
EditTime stores your projects, media, proxies, transcripts and review comments, stored on your computer and in Cloudly.

## How it's used
To run EditTime, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside EditTime.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage EditTime from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
EditTime's AI features analyse the footage and audio in your project to detect scenes, transcribe speech, reframe shots and clean up sound. They only process media you add to a project.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your EditTime data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your EditTime data
description: Get a copy of your EditTime data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose EditTime and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside EditTime at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your EditTime data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
EditTime exports include your projects, media, proxies, transcripts and review comments, stored on your computer and in Cloudly, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any EditTime subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Tips for getting the most out of EditTime
description: Small things that make a big difference in EditTime.
body:
- **Create a project:** Match the project frame rate to your camera to avoid stutter.
- **Transcript editing:** Remove filler words in one step with Clean up > Filler words.
- **Scene detection:** Lower the sensitivity for footage with fast camera moves.
- **Auto-captions:** Keep captions to two lines and about 40 characters per line for readability.
- **Colour grading:** Use AI > Match shots to start from a consistent base across angles.
- **Proxy workflows:** Store proxies on a fast SSD.
- **Collaborate on a project:** Use review links so producers can leave timecoded comments without installing EditTime.
- **Export and delivery:** Check the loudness meter against your platform's spec before exporting.

title: Troubleshooting EditTime
description: Fix common problems with EditTime.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update EditTime and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Some clips won't import](/docs/edittime-fix-some-clips-won-t-import)
- [The transcript has mistakes](/docs/edittime-fix-the-transcript-has-mistakes)
- [Scene detection finds too many cuts](/docs/edittime-fix-scene-detection-finds-too-many-cuts)
- [Captions are out of sync](/docs/edittime-fix-captions-are-out-of-sync)
- [Colours look different after export](/docs/edittime-fix-colours-look-different-after-export)
- [Playback stutters](/docs/edittime-fix-playback-stutters)
- [A sequence is locked](/docs/edittime-fix-a-sequence-is-locked)
- [Export fails](/docs/edittime-fix-export-fails)

## Still need help?
[Get help with EditTime](/docs/edittime-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to EditTime with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to EditTime.
- If you're using EditTime in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart EditTime completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for EditTime and for your device.
3. Sign out of EditTime, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/edittime-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of EditTime you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Create a project
description: In EditTime: start a project and import media.
body:
With EditTime you can start a project and import media. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- EditTime on one of its supported platforms: Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab.
- The latest version of EditTime and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open EditTime and choose New project.
2. Pick the frame size and frame rate.
3. Drag your media into the Media panel.

## Tip
Match the project frame rate to your camera to avoid stutter.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where EditTime is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- An unsupported codec
- Files still copying from the card

The quickest fixes:
1. Wait for copies to finish.
2. Use Media > Transcode to convert the clip.
3. Update EditTime for new camera formats.

For the full guide, see [Some clips won't import](/docs/edittime-fix-some-clips-won-t-import).

## Privacy and security
EditTime stores your projects, media, proxies, transcripts and review comments, stored on your computer and in Cloudly. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your EditTime data too.

title: A sequence is locked
description: EditTime: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Collaborate on a project** in EditTime and this happens: *a sequence is locked*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to EditTime with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to EditTime.
- If you're using EditTime in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- A teammate has it open

## How to fix it
1. Ask them to close it, or open a read-only copy.
2. An admin can release the lock.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart EditTime completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for EditTime and for your device.
3. Sign out of EditTime, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/edittime-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of EditTime you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Use review links so producers can leave timecoded comments without installing EditTime.

title: Export and delivery
description: In EditTime: export for any destination.
body:
With EditTime you can export for any destination. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- EditTime on one of its supported platforms: Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab.
- The latest version of EditTime and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Choose Deliver.
2. Pick a preset for your destination.
3. Select Export and track progress in the queue.

## Tip
Check the loudness meter against your platform's spec before exporting.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where EditTime is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Windows, macOS, Lu Book, Lu Tab) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Not enough disk space
- Offline media in the sequence

The quickest fixes:
1. Free up disk space.
2. Relink offline media.
3. Export a smaller range to find the problem clip.

For the full guide, see [Export fails](/docs/edittime-fix-export-fails).

## Privacy and security
EditTime stores your projects, media, proxies, transcripts and review comments, stored on your computer and in Cloudly. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your EditTime data too.

RanEddie Games is RanEddie's game studio and publisher — more than 50 games, made to shine on RanEddie Core, its own console.

## What's included
- **RanEddie Core** — A console built for RanEddie games.
- **50+ games** — Action, racing, puzzle, sports and family adventures.
- **Core Pass** — The full library, online play and cloud saves.
- **Core Controller** — Adaptive rumble, touch strip and days of battery.
- **Play together** — Online multiplayer, parties and couch co-op.
- **Family settings** — Play time, spending and age-rating controls.

## Where you can use it
- RanEddie Core
- Android
- Lu devices
- Streaming

## Next steps
- [Get started with RanEddie Games](/docs/raneddie-games-get-started)
- [Visit the RanEddie Games page](/raneddie-games)

## About RanEddie Games
RanEddie Games makes games — more than 50 of them, from quick arcade rounds to long adventures — and the console built to play them.

## RanEddie Core
RanEddie Core is the RanEddie Games console: designed around its own controller, fast loading and a library that's ready the moment you sign in with your RanEddie ID.

## The Core Controller
Comfortable grips, responsive triggers, a touch strip and adaptive rumble, with a battery that lasts for days.

## More than 50 games
Action, racing, puzzle, sports, party games and family adventures — including **Snake Brawl** — with new games added regularly.

## Core Pass
One subscription for the full library on day one, online play, cloud saves and member discounts.

## Play together
Online multiplayer, parties with voice chat, and couch co-op with up to four controllers.

## Your progress, everywhere
Cloud saves follow your RanEddie ID, so you can pick up on another Core or stream to Lu devices.

## Families
Family settings for play time, spending limits, age ratings and who kids can play with.

## Popular tasks

title: RanEddie Games and your privacy
description: What RanEddie Games stores and how you control it.
body:
## What RanEddie Games stores
RanEddie Games stores your game saves, achievements, friends list, purchases, Core Pass membership and family settings.

## How it's used
To run RanEddie Games, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside RanEddie Games.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage RanEddie Games from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Some RanEddie games use AI-driven opponents that adapt to how you play. Core also uses AI to suggest games you might like based on what you play.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your RanEddie Games data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

## Related articles
- [RanEddie Games availability and requirements](/docs/raneddie-games-availability-and-requirements) — Where RanEddie Games is available and what you need to use it.

title: Download or delete your RanEddie Games data
description: Get a copy of your RanEddie Games data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose RanEddie Games and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside RanEddie Games at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your RanEddie Games data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
RanEddie Games exports include your game saves, achievements, friends list, purchases, Core Pass membership and family settings, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any RanEddie Games subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Keep your RanEddie Games account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your RanEddie Games account.
body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your RanEddie Games account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects RanEddie Games too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep RanEddie Games updated.

## Watch out for scams
RanEddie will never ask for your password or a verification code. Learn to [recognise phishing](/docs/security-recognise-phishing).

## Signs something may be wrong
- Sign-in alerts you don't recognise.
- Changes to your RanEddie Games settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

title: Troubleshooting RanEddie Games
description: Fix common problems with RanEddie Games.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update RanEddie Games and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [The controller won't pair](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-the-controller-won-t-pair)
- [A game says I need to buy it](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-a-game-says-i-need-to-buy-it)
- [My save didn't sync](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-my-save-didn-t-sync)
- [I can't join my friend's game](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-i-can-t-join-my-friend-s-game)
- [My child can't play a game](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-my-child-can-t-play-a-game)
- [A download is stuck](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-a-download-is-stuck)
- [An achievement didn't unlock](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-an-achievement-didn-t-unlock)
- [Streaming is laggy](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-streaming-is-laggy)

## Still need help?
[Get help with RanEddie Games](/docs/raneddie-games-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to RanEddie Games with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to RanEddie Games.
- If you're using RanEddie Games in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Games completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Games and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Games, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-games-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Games you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Set up RanEddie Core
description: In RanEddie Games: connect your console and sign in.
body:
With RanEddie Games you can connect your console and sign in. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- RanEddie Games on one of its supported platforms: RanEddie Core, Android, Lu devices, Streaming.
- The latest version of RanEddie Games and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Connect Core to your TV with HDMI and plug it in.
2. Pair the Core Controller by holding the Home button.
3. Connect to the internet and sign in with your RanEddie ID.

## Tip
Use a wired connection for the fastest downloads.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where RanEddie Games is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (RanEddie Core, Android, Lu devices, Streaming) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- The battery is empty
- The controller is paired to another console

The quickest fixes:
1. Charge the controller with the USB-C cable.
2. Hold Home and Share together for 5 seconds to enter pairing mode.

For the full guide, see [The controller won't pair](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-the-controller-won-t-pair).

RanEddie Games stores your game saves, achievements, friends list, purchases, Core Pass membership and family settings. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Games data too.

With RanEddie Games you can join Core Pass for the full game library. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- RanEddie Games on one of its supported platforms: RanEddie Core, Android, Lu devices, Streaming.
- The latest version of RanEddie Games and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Store > Core Pass on your console.
2. Choose a plan.
3. Confirm with your RanEddie ID.

## Tip
Games in Core Pass can be downloaded and played while your membership is active.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where RanEddie Games is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (RanEddie Core, Android, Lu devices, Streaming) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- The game left Core Pass
- Your membership expired

The quickest fixes:
1. Check your membership in Settings > Account.
2. Buy the game to keep playing, often with a member discount.

For the full guide, see [A game says I need to buy it](/docs/raneddie-games-fix-a-game-says-i-need-to-buy-it).

## Privacy and security
RanEddie Games stores your game saves, achievements, friends list, purchases, Core Pass membership and family settings. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Games data too.

- [RanEddie Games and your privacy](/docs/raneddie-games-privacy)
- [Keep your RanEddie Games account secure](/docs/raneddie-games-security)

## More you can do in RanEddie Games

- [Stream games to Lu devices](/docs/raneddie-games-stream-games-to-lu-devices) — play Core games on a Lu Phone, Lu Tab or Lu Stream.

## Terms used in RanEddie Games

body:
This article helps when you're using **Core Pass** in RanEddie Games and this happens: *a game says i need to buy it*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to RanEddie Games with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to RanEddie Games.
- If you're using RanEddie Games in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- The game left Core Pass
- Your membership expired

## How to fix it
1. Check your membership in Settings > Account.
2. Buy the game to keep playing, often with a member discount.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Games completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Games and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Games, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-games-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Games you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

Games in Core Pass can be downloaded and played while your membership is active.

description: RanEddie Games: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Storage and downloads** in RanEddie Games and this happens: *a download is stuck*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:

- Not enough space
- A weak connection

title: Gimbly overview
description: Gimbly is a pocket-size flying camera with a built-in stabiliser and an AI director — it launches from your palm, follows the action, frames every shot and edits the story for you.
body:
Gimbly is a pocket-size flying camera with a built-in stabiliser and an AI director — it launches from your palm, follows the action, frames every shot and edits the story for you.

## What's included
- **Palm launch & landing** — Takes off from your hand — no controller needed.
- **AI director** — Chooses the moves and keeps the subject framed.
- **3-axis gimbal** — Smooth footage, even in wind.
- **Gestures & voice** — Wave, raise a hand or just ask.
- **Obstacle sensing** — Flies safely indoors, outdoors and near people.
- **Auto-edit** — A finished clip on your phone, ready for EditTime.

## Where you can use it
- Gimbly
- Lu Phone
- EditTime

## Next steps
- [Get started with Gimbly](/docs/gimbly-get-started)
- [Visit the Gimbly page](/gimbly)

## About Gimbly
Gimbly folds to the size of a phone, opens in your hand and lifts off from your palm. It's a flying camera with a three-axis stabiliser and an AI director that decides where to fly, how to frame the shot and when to roll.

## Launch from your hand
Open Gimbly, hold it flat and it takes off on its own — no controller needed. Hold out your palm to land it.

## An AI director on board
Tell Gimbly what you're doing — running, cycling, a family picnic, a product shot — and it chooses the moves: orbits, reveals, follows and slow pull-backs, keeping the subject perfectly framed.

## Rock-steady footage
A three-axis gimbal and electronic stabilisation keep footage smooth, even in wind or while following fast action.

## Gestures and voice
Wave to start a shot, raise a hand for a photo, or say "Gimbly, follow me".

## Indoor and outdoor
Obstacle sensing on every side lets Gimbly fly indoors and through trees, and slows it down near people.

## Your story, edited
When you land, Gimbly sends its clips to your phone and builds a short edit with music. Open it in EditTime to refine it.

## Safe and responsible
Built-in geofencing respects no-fly zones, propellers are fully guarded, and a privacy mode stops Gimbly from recording people who haven't been added to your shot.

## Popular tasks
- [First flight](/docs/gimbly-first-flight) — set up Gimbly and fly for the first time.
- [AI director shots](/docs/gimbly-ai-director-shots) — let the AI choose camera moves for your activity.
- [Gesture control](/docs/gimbly-gesture-control) — control Gimbly with your hands.
- [Auto-edit](/docs/gimbly-auto-edit) — get a finished edit after you land.
- [Privacy mode](/docs/gimbly-privacy-mode) — avoid recording people who aren't in your shot.
- [Batteries and charging](/docs/gimbly-batteries-and-charging) — charge and care for Gimbly batteries.
- [Flying rules](/docs/gimbly-flying-rules) — fly safely and legally.
- [Firmware updates](/docs/gimbly-firmware-updates) — keep Gimbly up to date.

## Terms used in Gimbly
- **Gimbal** — A motorised mount that keeps the camera steady.
- **Geofencing** — Built-in limits that stop Gimbly flying in restricted areas.
- **AI director** — Gimbly's on-board system that plans camera moves.

## Learn more
- [Gimbly FAQ](/docs/gimbly-faq)
- [Troubleshooting Gimbly](/docs/gimbly-troubleshooting)
- [Gimbly and your privacy](/docs/gimbly-privacy)

## Related articles

- [Gimbly availability and requirements](/docs/gimbly-availability-and-requirements) — Where Gimbly is available and what you need to use it.

- Try **First flight**: set up Gimbly and fly for the first time. [How to](/docs/gimbly-first-flight)
- Try **AI director shots**: let the AI choose camera moves for your activity. [How to](/docs/gimbly-ai-director-shots)

- Try **Auto-edit**: get a finished edit after you land. [How to](/docs/gimbly-auto-edit)
- Try **Privacy mode**: avoid recording people who aren't in your shot. [How to](/docs/gimbly-privacy-mode)
- Try **Batteries and charging**: charge and care for Gimbly batteries. [How to](/docs/gimbly-batteries-and-charging)
- Try **Flying rules**: fly safely and legally. [How to](/docs/gimbly-flying-rules)
- Try **Firmware updates**: keep Gimbly up to date. [How to](/docs/gimbly-firmware-updates)

## Secure your account
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained) for your RanEddie ID.
- Review [Keep your Gimbly account secure](/docs/gimbly-security).

## Check your privacy settings
Take a minute to review [Gimbly and your privacy](/docs/gimbly-privacy) and choose what suits you.

## Terms used in Gimbly
- **Gimbal** — A motorised mount that keeps the camera steady.
- **Geofencing** — Built-in limits that stop Gimbly flying in restricted areas.

title: Gimbly and your privacy
description: What Gimbly stores and how you control it.
body:
## What Gimbly stores
Gimbly stores your photos and videos, flight logs and the people you add to your shots.

## How it's used
To run Gimbly, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Gimbly.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Gimbly from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Gimbly's AI director recognises the subject you choose, plans camera moves and avoids obstacles on the device itself. Face recognition is only used for people you add to your shot, and you can delete them at any time.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Gimbly data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your Gimbly data
description: Get a copy of your Gimbly data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Gimbly and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Gimbly at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Gimbly data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Gimbly exports include your photos and videos, flight logs and the people you add to your shots, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any Gimbly subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Keep your Gimbly account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your Gimbly account.
body:

Your Gimbly account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects Gimbly too.

Yes — obstacle sensing works indoors, and Gimbly flies more slowly near people.

title: Troubleshooting Gimbly
description: Fix common problems with Gimbly.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Gimbly and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Gimbly won't take off](/docs/gimbly-fix-gimbly-won-t-take-off)
- [Gimbly loses track of me](/docs/gimbly-fix-gimbly-loses-track-of-me)
- [Gestures don't work](/docs/gimbly-fix-gestures-don-t-work)
- [Clips won't transfer](/docs/gimbly-fix-clips-won-t-transfer)
- [Faces are blurred in my video](/docs/gimbly-fix-faces-are-blurred-in-my-video)
- [Flight time is shorter than usual](/docs/gimbly-fix-flight-time-is-shorter-than-usual)
- [The app says I need to register](/docs/gimbly-fix-the-app-says-i-need-to-register)
- [An update failed](/docs/gimbly-fix-an-update-failed)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Gimbly](/docs/gimbly-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Gimbly with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Gimbly.
- If you're using Gimbly in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Gimbly completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Gimbly and for your device.
3. Sign out of Gimbly, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/gimbly-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Gimbly you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

- Privacy mode blurs people you haven't added

title: Cloudly overview
description: Cloudly is RanEddie's cloud — storage, sharing and backup for everyone, plus computing, hosting and storage infrastructure for developers and businesses.
body:
Cloudly is RanEddie's cloud — storage, sharing and backup for everyone, plus computing, hosting and storage infrastructure for developers and businesses.

## What's included
- **Cloudly Drive** — Store, search and share files from any device.
- **Cloudly Photos** — Automatic backup and search for your photos.
- **Cloudly Backup** — Restore your devices and computers when you need to.
- **Compute & Functions** — Servers, containers and event-driven code.
- **Object Storage & CDN** — Durable storage delivered worldwide.
- **Encrypted** — Encrypted in transit and at rest.

## Where you can use it
- Web
- Windows
- macOS
- Lu devices
- Android
- API

## Next steps
- [Get started with Cloudly](/docs/cloudly-get-started)
- [Visit the Cloudly page](/cloudly)

## About Cloudly
Cloudly is two clouds in one. For people, it's a safe place for files, photos and backups that you can reach from any device. For developers and businesses, it's the infrastructure to run apps and store data at any scale.

## Cloudly Drive
Store any file, organise it in folders, search it instantly and open it on any device. Share with a link and choose who can view or edit.

## Cloudly Photos
Back up photos and videos automatically from your phone, find them by what's in them, and share albums with family.

## Cloudly Backup
Keep a copy of your Lu devices, computers and workIT files, and restore them when you need to.

## Cloudly for Business
Shared drives, admin controls, retention policies and audit logs for teams of every size.

## Cloudly Compute
Virtual servers and containers in regions around the world, with autoscaling and load balancing.

## Cloudly Functions
Run code in response to events without managing servers.

## Cloudly Object Storage
Durable storage for any amount of data, with lifecycle rules and a global content delivery network.

## Built for developers
APIs, a command-line tool and SDKs for popular languages — and baseline for a ready-made backend on top of Cloudly.

## Secure by default
Files are encrypted in transit and at rest, and two-step verification with your RanEddie ID protects your account.

## Popular tasks
- [Upload files to Cloudly Drive](/docs/cloudly-upload-files-to-cloudly-drive) — add files and folders to Cloudly Drive.
- [Share a file or folder](/docs/cloudly-share-a-file-or-folder) — share with people or with a link.
- [Back up your photos](/docs/cloudly-back-up-your-photos) — back up photos and videos from your phone.
- [Restore deleted files](/docs/cloudly-restore-deleted-files) — get back files you deleted.
- [Storage plans](/docs/cloudly-storage-plans) — see and change your storage.
- [Deploy a server with Cloudly Compute](/docs/cloudly-deploy-a-server-with-cloudly-compute) — create a virtual server.
- [Cloudly Functions](/docs/cloudly-cloudly-functions) — run code when something happens.
- [Object storage buckets](/docs/cloudly-object-storage-buckets) — store data for apps in buckets.

## Terms used in Cloudly
- **Bucket** — A container for files in Cloudly Object Storage.
- **Region** — A location where Cloudly runs your resources.
- **Sync** — Keeping a folder the same on your computer and in Cloudly.
- **CDN** — A network that delivers files from locations near your users.

## Learn more
- [Cloudly FAQ](/docs/cloudly-faq)
- [Troubleshooting Cloudly](/docs/cloudly-troubleshooting)
- [Cloudly and your privacy](/docs/cloudly-privacy)

title: Cloudly and your privacy
description: What Cloudly stores and how you control it.
body:
## What Cloudly stores
Cloudly stores your files, photos, backups and, for developers, the resources and data you create.

## How it's used
To run Cloudly, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Cloudly.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Cloudly from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Cloudly Photos uses AI to recognise what's in your photos so you can search for things like 'beach' or 'birthday cake'. You can turn off people recognition at any time.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Cloudly data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your Cloudly data
description: Get a copy of your Cloudly data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Cloudly and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Cloudly at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Cloudly data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Cloudly exports include your files, photos, backups and, for developers, the resources and data you create, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any Cloudly subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

Your Cloudly account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects Cloudly too.

- Changes to your Cloudly settings you didn't make.

title: Cloudly glossary
description: Terms you'll see in Cloudly.
body:
- **Bucket** — A container for files in Cloudly Object Storage.
- **Region** — A location where Cloudly runs your resources.
- **Sync** — Keeping a folder the same on your computer and in Cloudly.
- **CDN** — A network that delivers files from locations near your users.
- **RanEddie ID** — the account you use across every RanEddie product.

## General RanEddie terms
- **RanEddie ID** — the one account you use across every RanEddie product.
- **Account Center** — where you manage your RanEddie ID at id.raneddie.com/account.
- **Two-step verification** — a second check, like an authenticator code, after your password.
- **Session** — a device or browser where you're signed in.
- **Cloudly** — RanEddie's cloud, where your files and backups live.

title: Troubleshooting Cloudly
description: Fix common problems with Cloudly.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Cloudly and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [An upload is stuck](/docs/cloudly-fix-an-upload-is-stuck)
- [People can't open my link](/docs/cloudly-fix-people-can-t-open-my-link)
- [Photos aren't backing up](/docs/cloudly-fix-photos-aren-t-backing-up)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Cloudly](/docs/cloudly-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Cloudly with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Cloudly.
- If you're using Cloudly in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Cloudly completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Cloudly and for your device.
3. Sign out of Cloudly, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.

- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Cloudly you're using.

- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Upload files to Cloudly Drive
description: In Cloudly: add files and folders to Cloudly Drive.
body:
With Cloudly you can add files and folders to Cloudly Drive. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Cloudly on one of its supported platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Lu devices, Android, API.
- The latest version of Cloudly and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Cloudly Drive.
2. Select Upload, or drag files into the window.
3. Organise them into folders.

## Tip
Install Cloudly on your computer to sync a folder automatically.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Cloudly is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web, Windows, macOS, Lu devices, Android, API) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- A slow connection
- The file is bigger than your remaining storage

The quickest fixes:
1. Check your storage in Settings.
2. Pause and resume the upload.
3. Try a wired or faster connection.

For the full guide, see [An upload is stuck](/docs/cloudly-fix-an-upload-is-stuck).

## Privacy and security
Cloudly stores your files, photos, backups and, for developers, the resources and data you create. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your Cloudly data too.

- [Cloudly and your privacy](/docs/cloudly-privacy)
- [Keep your Cloudly account secure](/docs/cloudly-security)

## More you can do in Cloudly
- [Share a file or folder](/docs/cloudly-share-a-file-or-folder) — share with people or with a link.

- [Restore deleted files](/docs/cloudly-restore-deleted-files) — get back files you deleted.
- [Storage plans](/docs/cloudly-storage-plans) — see and change your storage.
- [Deploy a server with Cloudly Compute](/docs/cloudly-deploy-a-server-with-cloudly-compute) — create a virtual server.
- [Cloudly Functions](/docs/cloudly-cloudly-functions) — run code when something happens.
- [Object storage buckets](/docs/cloudly-object-storage-buckets) — store data for apps in buckets.

## Terms used in Cloudly
- **Bucket** — A container for files in Cloudly Object Storage.
- **Region** — A location where Cloudly runs your resources.
- **Sync** — Keeping a folder the same on your computer and in Cloudly.
- **CDN** — A network that delivers files from locations near your users.

- Look for an update to Cloudly.
- If you're using Cloudly in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

- It was deleted more than 30 days ago
- It was deleted by the owner of a shared folder

2. Install any available updates for Cloudly and for your device.
3. Sign out of Cloudly, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.

title: Access denied when reading a file
description: Cloudly: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Object storage buckets** in Cloudly and this happens: *access denied when reading a file*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Cloudly with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Cloudly.
- If you're using Cloudly in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- The bucket is private
- The access key lacks permission

## How to fix it
1. Use a signed URL.
2. Grant the key read access to the bucket.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Cloudly completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Cloudly and for your device.
3. Sign out of Cloudly, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/cloudly-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Cloudly you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Keep buckets private and share files with signed URLs.

## About Object storage buckets
Cloudly lets you store data for apps in buckets. See [Object storage buckets](/docs/cloudly-object-storage-buckets) for the full how-to.

body:
RanEddie Invest is an investing app for buying and selling stocks and ETFs, building a long-term portfolio and following the markets — with clear fees and plain-language explanations.

## What's included
- **Stocks & ETFs** — Including fractional shares from a small amount.
- **Recurring investing** — Invest automatically every week or month.
- **Clear fees** — See every fee before you confirm.
- **Watchlists & alerts** — Follow companies and price moves.
- **Learn as you go** — Plain-language explanations everywhere.
- **Secure** — RanEddie ID, two-step verification and protected withdrawals.

## Where you can use it
- Lu Phone
- Android
- Web

## Next steps
- [Get started with RanEddie Invest](/docs/raneddie-invest-get-started)
- [Visit the RanEddie Invest page](/raneddie-invest)

## About RanEddie Invest
RanEddie Invest is built for people who want to invest without the jargon: open an account in minutes, buy stocks and ETFs, set up regular investing and always see exactly what you pay.

## Stocks and ETFs
Buy and sell shares and exchange-traded funds from major markets, including fractional shares so you can start with a small amount.

## Recurring investments
Invest a fixed amount every week or month automatically.

## Clear fees
Every fee is shown before you confirm an order — no surprises.

## Watchlists and alerts
Follow the companies you care about and get alerts when prices move.

## Learn as you go
Plain-language explanations of every term, chart and order type, right where you need them.

## Security
Sign in with your RanEddie ID and two-step verification; withdrawals only go to accounts in your name.

## Important
Investing involves risk, including the possible loss of the money you invest. Past performance doesn't guarantee future results. RanEddie Invest doesn't provide personal financial advice. Availability depends on your country.

## Popular tasks
- [Open an account](/docs/raneddie-invest-open-an-account) — open a RanEddie Invest account.
- [Add money](/docs/raneddie-invest-add-money) — deposit money to invest.
- [Buy a stock or ETF](/docs/raneddie-invest-buy-a-stock-or-etf) — place an order.

- [Watchlists and alerts](/docs/raneddie-invest-watchlists-and-alerts) — follow companies and get price alerts.
- [Withdraw money](/docs/raneddie-invest-withdraw-money) — move money back to your bank.
- [Tax documents](/docs/raneddie-invest-tax-documents) — download your tax documents.
- [Understand fees](/docs/raneddie-invest-understand-fees) — see what you pay.

## Terms used in RanEddie Invest
- **ETF** — An exchange-traded fund: a basket of investments you can buy as one.
- **Fractional share** — Part of a single share.
- **Limit order** — An order that only runs at your price or better.
- **Settlement** — When a trade is completed and money moves.

title: RanEddie Invest and your privacy
description: What RanEddie Invest stores and how you control it.
body:
## What RanEddie Invest stores
RanEddie Invest stores your identity verification details, bank accounts, orders, holdings and tax documents.

## How it's used
To run RanEddie Invest, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside RanEddie Invest.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage RanEddie Invest from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
RanEddie Invest can explain financial terms and summarise company news in plain language. It doesn't tell you what to buy or sell.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your RanEddie Invest data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

title: Download or delete your RanEddie Invest data
description: Get a copy of your RanEddie Invest data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose RanEddie Invest and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside RanEddie Invest at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your RanEddie Invest data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
RanEddie Invest exports include your identity verification details, bank accounts, orders, holdings and tax documents, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any RanEddie Invest subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

title: Troubleshooting RanEddie Invest
description: Fix common problems with RanEddie Invest.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update RanEddie Invest and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Identity verification failed](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-identity-verification-failed)
- [My deposit hasn't arrived](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-my-deposit-hasn-t-arrived)
- [My order didn't go through](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-my-order-didn-t-go-through)
- [A recurring investment was skipped](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-a-recurring-investment-was-skipped)
- [I didn't get an alert](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-i-didn-t-get-an-alert)
- [I can't withdraw everything](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-i-can-t-withdraw-everything)
- [My tax document isn't available yet](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-my-tax-document-isn-t-available-yet)
- [A fee looks unexpected](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-a-fee-looks-unexpected)

## Still need help?
[Get help with RanEddie Invest](/docs/raneddie-invest-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to RanEddie Invest with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to RanEddie Invest.
- If you're using RanEddie Invest in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Invest completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Invest and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Invest, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-invest-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Invest you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

body:
With RanEddie Invest you can open a RanEddie Invest account. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- RanEddie Invest on one of its supported platforms: Lu Phone, Android, Web.
- The latest version of RanEddie Invest and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Sign in with your RanEddie ID.
2. Verify your identity with a photo ID.
3. Answer a few questions about your experience and goals.

## Tip
Identity verification is required by law and usually takes a few minutes.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where RanEddie Invest is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Lu Phone, Android, Web) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- A blurry photo
- Your name doesn't match your ID

The quickest fixes:
1. Retake the photo in good light.
2. Make sure your RanEddie ID name matches your ID.
3. Contact support if it fails again.

For the full guide, see [Identity verification failed](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-identity-verification-failed).

RanEddie Invest stores your identity verification details, bank accounts, orders, holdings and tax documents. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Invest data too.

With RanEddie Invest you can download your tax documents. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- RanEddie Invest on one of its supported platforms: Lu Phone, Android, Web.
- The latest version of RanEddie Invest and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Account > Documents.
2. Choose the tax year.
3. Download or share the document.

## Tip
RanEddie Invest can't give tax advice — talk to a tax professional.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where RanEddie Invest is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Lu Phone, Android, Web) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Documents are released after the tax year ends

The quickest fixes:
1. Check back after the date shown in Documents.

For the full guide, see [My tax document isn't available yet](/docs/raneddie-invest-fix-my-tax-document-isn-t-available-yet).

## Privacy and security
RanEddie Invest stores your identity verification details, bank accounts, orders, holdings and tax documents. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your RanEddie Invest data too.

- [RanEddie Invest and your privacy](/docs/raneddie-invest-privacy)
- [Keep your RanEddie Invest account secure](/docs/raneddie-invest-security)

## More you can do in RanEddie Invest
- [Open an account](/docs/raneddie-invest-open-an-account) — open a RanEddie Invest account.
- [Add money](/docs/raneddie-invest-add-money) — deposit money to invest.
- [Buy a stock or ETF](/docs/raneddie-invest-buy-a-stock-or-etf) — place an order.
- [Recurring investments](/docs/raneddie-invest-recurring-investments) — invest automatically on a schedule.
- [Watchlists and alerts](/docs/raneddie-invest-watchlists-and-alerts) — follow companies and get price alerts.
- [Withdraw money](/docs/raneddie-invest-withdraw-money) — move money back to your bank.
- [Understand fees](/docs/raneddie-invest-understand-fees) — see what you pay.

## Terms used in RanEddie Invest
- **ETF** — An exchange-traded fund: a basket of investments you can buy as one.
- **Fractional share** — Part of a single share.
- **Limit order** — An order that only runs at your price or better.
- **Settlement** — When a trade is completed and money moves.

title: My tax document isn't available yet
description: RanEddie Invest: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Tax documents** in RanEddie Invest and this happens: *my tax document isn't available yet*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to RanEddie Invest with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to RanEddie Invest.
- If you're using RanEddie Invest in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- Documents are released after the tax year ends

## How to fix it
1. Check back after the date shown in Documents.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart RanEddie Invest completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for RanEddie Invest and for your device.
3. Sign out of RanEddie Invest, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/raneddie-invest-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of RanEddie Invest you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
RanEddie Invest can't give tax advice — talk to a tax professional.

## About Tax documents
RanEddie Invest lets you download your tax documents. See [Tax documents](/docs/raneddie-invest-tax-documents) for the full how-to.

title: rEmail overview
description: rEmail is RanEddie's email service — a clean inbox with strong spam protection, smart organisation, custom addresses and AI that helps you write and catch up.
body:
rEmail is RanEddie's email service — a clean inbox with strong spam protection, smart organisation, custom addresses and AI that helps you write and catch up.

## What's included
- **Smart inbox** — Primary, Updates, Promotions and Social sorted for you.
- **Spam & phishing protection** — Threats filtered before they reach you.
- **rEmail Assist** — Draft replies, rewrite text and summarise threads.
- **Aliases & custom domains** — Protect your address or use your own domain.
- **Schedule & undo send** — Send later, or take it back.
- **Calendar & contacts** — Built in and synced everywhere.

## Where you can use it
- Web
- Lu devices
- Android
- Windows
- macOS

## Next steps
- [Get started with rEmail](/docs/remail-get-started)
- [Visit the rEmail page](/remail)

## About rEmail
rEmail gives you an @remail address, or works with your own domain, with an inbox that sorts itself and keeps the noise out.

## A calmer inbox
rEmail sorts incoming mail into Primary, Updates, Promotions and Social, so the messages that matter are first.

## Spam and phishing protection
Suspicious messages are filtered before they reach you, and links and attachments are checked for threats with help from Protector Y.

## Write faster
Smart compose suggests the rest of your sentence, and rEmail Assist can draft a reply or rewrite a paragraph in a different tone. You always review before sending.

## Catch up quickly
Summaries of long threads, a daily digest and snooze to bring a message back when you're ready.

## Your address, your way
Aliases to protect your real address, custom domains for your business, and filters that file mail automatically.

## Schedule and undo
Schedule messages for later, and undo a send for a few seconds after you press it.

## Calendar and contacts
Invitations, a calendar and your contacts, built in and synced to every device.

## Private by design
rEmail doesn't use the content of your email for advertising. Messages are encrypted in transit and at rest.

## Popular tasks
- [Create an rEmail address](/docs/remail-create-an-remail-address) — get an @remail address.
- [Filters and labels](/docs/remail-filters-and-labels) — sort mail automatically.
- [Aliases](/docs/remail-aliases) — use extra addresses that deliver to your inbox.
- [Custom domains](/docs/remail-custom-domains) — use your own domain with rEmail.
- [Schedule and undo send](/docs/remail-schedule-and-undo-send) — send later or take a message back.
- [rEmail Assist](/docs/remail-remail-assist) — draft replies and summarise long threads.
- [Report phishing](/docs/remail-report-phishing) — report suspicious email.
- [Use rEmail in another mail app](/docs/remail-use-remail-in-another-mail-app) — connect rEmail to other email apps.

## Terms used in rEmail
- **Alias** — An extra address that delivers to your inbox.
- **Phishing** — Fake messages that try to steal information.
- **DNS** — Settings that tell the internet where your domain's mail goes.
- **App password** — A separate password for other email apps.

## Learn more
- [rEmail FAQ](/docs/remail-faq)
- [Troubleshooting rEmail](/docs/remail-troubleshooting)
- [rEmail and your privacy](/docs/remail-privacy)

## Related articles
- [Get started with rEmail](/docs/remail-get-started) — Everything you need for your first day with rEmail.
- [rEmail availability and requirements](/docs/remail-availability-and-requirements) — Where rEmail is available and what you need to use it.
- [Sign in to rEmail with your RanEddie ID](/docs/remail-sign-in) — Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to rEmail.

title: Sign in to rEmail with your RanEddie ID
description: Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to rEmail.
body:
## Sign in
1. Open rEmail.
2. Choose Sign in.
3. Sign in at id.raneddie.com — you're returned to rEmail automatically.

## On a TV or console
Choose Sign in, then enter the code shown on screen at id.raneddie.com on your phone. See [Sign in on a TV or console](/docs/sign-in-on-a-tv-or-console).
