- [Why does the sign-in page keep loading?](/docs/sign-in-why-does-the-sign-in-page-keep-loading)

You can be signed in to rEmail on more than one device at the same time. Each device appears under Active sessions in your Account Center, where you can sign it out remotely.

## Signing out
Choose Sign out from rEmail's account menu. To sign out everywhere at once, revoke your sessions from the Security page of your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).

## Keep sign-in safe
- Sign in only at id.raneddie.com.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).

title: rEmail and your privacy
description: What rEmail stores and how you control it.
body:
## What rEmail stores
rEmail stores your email messages, attachments, contacts, calendar events and filters.

## How it's used
To run rEmail, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside rEmail.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage rEmail from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
rEmail Assist drafts replies and summarises threads when you ask it to. It works on the messages you choose, and rEmail never uses your email content for advertising.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your rEmail data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

## Related articles

title: Download or delete your rEmail data
description: Get a copy of your rEmail data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose rEmail and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside rEmail at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your rEmail data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
rEmail exports include your email messages, attachments, contacts, calendar events and filters, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any rEmail subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

## Related articles

- [rEmail and your privacy](/docs/remail-privacy) — What rEmail stores and how you control it.

title: Keep your rEmail account secure
description: Simple steps to protect your rEmail account.
body:
## Protect your RanEddie ID
Your rEmail account is your RanEddie ID, so securing it protects rEmail too.
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters.
- Turn on [two-step verification](/docs/sign-in-two-step-verification-explained).
- Review [recent sign-ins](/docs/sign-in-review-recent-sign-ins) regularly.
- Keep rEmail updated.

## Watch out for scams

rEmail stores your email messages, attachments, contacts, calendar events and filters. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your rEmail data too.

title: Troubleshooting rEmail
description: Fix common problems with rEmail.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update rEmail and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [The address I want is taken](/docs/remail-fix-the-address-i-want-is-taken)
- [A filter isn't working](/docs/remail-fix-a-filter-isn-t-working)
- [I'm getting spam on an alias](/docs/remail-fix-i-m-getting-spam-on-an-alias)
- [My domain won't verify](/docs/remail-fix-my-domain-won-t-verify)
- [Undo send didn't appear](/docs/remail-fix-undo-send-didn-t-appear)
- [Assist isn't available](/docs/remail-fix-assist-isn-t-available)
- [A real message went to spam](/docs/remail-fix-a-real-message-went-to-spam)
- [My mail app can't sign in](/docs/remail-fix-my-mail-app-can-t-sign-in)

## Still need help?
[Get help with rEmail](/docs/remail-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to rEmail with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to rEmail.
- If you're using rEmail in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart rEmail completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for rEmail and for your device.
3. Sign out of rEmail, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/remail-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of rEmail you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:

- Look for an update to rEmail.

body:

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to rEmail with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to rEmail.
- If you're using rEmail in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

- The sender is new or sends lots of mail

2. Add the sender to your contacts.

title: baseline overview
description: baseline gives developers a complete backend in minutes — a Postgres database, authentication, file storage, realtime, edge functions and instant APIs — running on Cloudly.
body:
baseline gives developers a complete backend in minutes — a Postgres database, authentication, file storage, realtime, edge functions and instant APIs — running on Cloudly.

## What's included
- **Postgres database** — Full Postgres with backups and point-in-time recovery.
- **Instant APIs** — REST and GraphQL for every table.
- **Auth & row-level security** — Including Sign in with RanEddie ID.
- **Storage** — Files with image transformations and access rules.
- **Realtime & edge functions** — Live updates and server code near your users.
- **Branching** — A database per pull request.

## Where you can use it
- Web dashboard
- CLI
- JavaScript
- Python
- Swift
- Kotlin

## Next steps
- [Get started with baseline](/docs/baseline-get-started)
- [Visit the baseline page](/baseline)

## About baseline
baseline is a backend platform for building web and mobile apps. Every project starts with a full Postgres database and adds everything an app needs around it — so you write your product, not plumbing.

## Postgres database
A dedicated Postgres database with extensions, a table editor, a SQL editor, backups and point-in-time recovery.

## Instant APIs
Every table gets REST and GraphQL APIs automatically, with typed client libraries.

## Authentication
Email, passwords, magic links, social sign-in and **Sign in with RanEddie ID**, with row-level security to control who can read and write each row.

## Storage
Store and serve files, with image transformations and the same security rules as your database.

## Realtime
Listen to database changes, broadcast messages and track who's online.

## Edge functions
Run server-side code close to your users.

## Branching
Create a branch of your project for every pull request, with its own database.

## Built on Cloudly
Choose a region, scale compute as you grow and keep your data where you need it.

## Popular tasks
- [Create a project](/docs/baseline-create-a-project) — start a new baseline project.
- [Create tables](/docs/baseline-create-tables) — design your database schema.
- [Row-level security](/docs/baseline-row-level-security) — control access to each row.
- [Authentication](/docs/baseline-authentication) — add sign-in to your app.
- [Storage buckets](/docs/baseline-storage-buckets) — upload and serve files.
- [Realtime](/docs/baseline-realtime) — listen to changes as they happen.
- [Edge functions](/docs/baseline-edge-functions) — deploy server-side code.
- [Backups and restore](/docs/baseline-backups-and-restore) — recover your database.

## Terms used in baseline
- **RLS** — Row-level security: rules for who can access each row.
- **Migration** — A versioned change to your database schema.
- **Service key** — A secret key with full access — server-side only.
- **Edge function** — Server code that runs near your users.

## Learn more
- [baseline FAQ](/docs/baseline-faq)
- [Troubleshooting baseline](/docs/baseline-troubleshooting)
- [baseline and your privacy](/docs/baseline-privacy)

## Related articles
- [Get started with baseline](/docs/baseline-get-started) — Everything you need for your first day with baseline.
- [baseline availability and requirements](/docs/baseline-availability-and-requirements) — Where baseline is available and what you need to use it.
- [Sign in to baseline with your RanEddie ID](/docs/baseline-sign-in) — Use your RanEddie ID to sign in to baseline.

title: baseline and your privacy
description: What baseline stores and how you control it.
body:
## What baseline stores
baseline stores the projects you create and the data your apps store in them.

## How it's used
To run baseline, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside baseline.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage baseline from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
baseline's SQL assistant can write queries, explain errors and suggest indexes from a plain-language description. Review generated SQL before running it on production data.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your baseline data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

## Related articles

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your baseline data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
baseline exports include the projects you create and the data your apps store in them, in common formats you can open with other apps.

- Cancel any baseline subscriptions.

- Keep baseline updated.

- Changes to your baseline settings you didn't make.
- Purchases you didn't make.

If you see any of these, follow [My account was hacked](/docs/security-my-account-was-hacked) right away.

baseline stores the projects you create and the data your apps store in them. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your baseline data too.

title: Tips for getting the most out of baseline
description: Small things that make a big difference in baseline.
body:
- **Create a project:** Pick the region closest to your users.
- **Create tables:** Use migrations from the CLI to keep schema changes in version control.
- **Row-level security:** Never expose the service key in client-side code.
- **Authentication:** Add your app's URLs to the allowed redirect list.
- **Storage buckets:** Use image transformations to serve the right size for each screen.
- **Realtime:** Realtime respects row-level security, so users only get rows they can read.
- **Edge functions:** Store secrets with baseline secrets set instead of in code.
- **Backups and restore:** Restore to a new project first to check the data.

title: Troubleshooting baseline
description: Fix common problems with baseline.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update baseline and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Project creation is taking a long time](/docs/baseline-fix-project-creation-is-taking-a-long-time)
- [Inserts are blocked](/docs/baseline-fix-inserts-are-blocked)
- [Users can see each other's data](/docs/baseline-fix-users-can-see-each-other-s-data)
- [Sign-in redirects fail](/docs/baseline-fix-sign-in-redirects-fail)
- [Uploads are denied](/docs/baseline-fix-uploads-are-denied)
- [No events arrive](/docs/baseline-fix-no-events-arrive)
- [A function returns 500](/docs/baseline-fix-a-function-returns-500)
- [The backup I need isn't listed](/docs/baseline-fix-the-backup-i-need-isn-t-listed)

## Still need help?
[Get help with baseline](/docs/baseline-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to baseline with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to baseline.
- If you're using baseline in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart baseline completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for baseline and for your device.
3. Sign out of baseline, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/baseline-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of baseline you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

body:

- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

1. Sign in to baseline with your RanEddie ID.
2. Choose New project, a name and a region.
3. Set a strong database password and create the project.

Pick the region closest to your users.

- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where baseline is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web dashboard, CLI, JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

- Provisioning a dedicated database takes a few minutes

- Make sure you're signed in to baseline with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to baseline.
- If you're using baseline in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

- A policy is too broad

- The device, operating system and version of baseline you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.

- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: A function returns 500
description: baseline: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Edge functions** in baseline and this happens: *a function returns 500*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to baseline with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to baseline.
- If you're using baseline in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- An unhandled error
- A missing secret

## How to fix it
1. Check the function logs.
2. Set the missing secrets.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart baseline completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for baseline and for your device.
3. Sign out of baseline, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/baseline-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of baseline you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Store secrets with baseline secrets set instead of in code.

title: Backups and restore
description: In baseline: recover your database.
body:
With baseline you can recover your database. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- baseline on one of its supported platforms: Web dashboard, CLI, JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin.
- The latest version of baseline and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Database > Backups.
2. Choose a daily backup or a point in time.
3. Restore to a new project or the same project.

## Tip
Restore to a new project first to check the data.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where baseline is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Web dashboard, CLI, JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Your plan's retention period has passed

The quickest fixes:
1. Check your plan's backup retention.

For the full guide, see [The backup I need isn't listed](/docs/baseline-fix-the-backup-i-need-isn-t-listed).

## Privacy and security
baseline stores the projects you create and the data your apps store in them. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your baseline data too.

- [baseline and your privacy](/docs/baseline-privacy)
- [Keep your baseline account secure](/docs/baseline-security)

## More you can do in baseline
- [Create a project](/docs/baseline-create-a-project) — start a new baseline project.

- [Row-level security](/docs/baseline-row-level-security) — control access to each row.
- [Authentication](/docs/baseline-authentication) — add sign-in to your app.
- [Storage buckets](/docs/baseline-storage-buckets) — upload and serve files.
- [Realtime](/docs/baseline-realtime) — listen to changes as they happen.
- [Edge functions](/docs/baseline-edge-functions) — deploy server-side code.

## Terms used in baseline
- **RLS** — Row-level security: rules for who can access each row.
- **Migration** — A versioned change to your database schema.
- **Service key** — A secret key with full access — server-side only.
- **Edge function** — Server code that runs near your users.

## Related articles
- [Edge functions](/docs/baseline-edge-functions) — In baseline: deploy server-side code.
- [A function returns 500](/docs/baseline-fix-a-function-returns-500) — baseline: why this happens and how to fix it.

title: Protector Y overview
description: Protector Y protects computers, phones and tablets from viruses, ransomware, dangerous websites and scams, with a secure VPN and a password manager.
body:
Protector Y protects computers, phones and tablets from viruses, ransomware, dangerous websites and scams, with a secure VPN and a password manager.

## What's included
- **Real-time protection** — Stops viruses, spyware and ransomware.
- **Safe browsing** — Blocks dangerous and fake websites.
- **Scam protection** — Warns about suspicious links in messages.
- **Secure VPN** — Encrypted browsing on public Wi-Fi.
- **Password manager** — Strong passwords, filled in everywhere.
- **Identity alerts** — Know when your email appears in a breach.

## Where you can use it
- Windows
- macOS
- Android
- Lu devices
- Browser extension

## Next steps
- [Get started with Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-get-started)
- [Visit the Protector Y page](/protector-y)

## About Protector Y
Protector Y keeps your devices and your identity safe without slowing you down. One subscription covers every device in your household.

## Real-time protection
Protector Y scans files and apps as they arrive and as they run, stopping viruses, spyware and ransomware before they do damage.

## Safe browsing
Dangerous and fake websites are blocked before they load, on every browser, with the Protector Y extension.

## Scam and phishing protection
Protector Y warns you about suspicious links in messages and email.

## Ransomware shield
Protected folders can only be changed by apps you trust.

## Secure VPN
Encrypt your connection on public Wi-Fi with one tap.

## Password manager
Strong, unique passwords for every site, filled in automatically and synced across your devices.

## Identity alerts
Get notified if your email address appears in a known data breach, with steps to secure your accounts.

## Light on your device
Scans run when you're not busy, and gaming mode pauses notifications while you play.

## Popular tasks
- [Install Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-install-protector-y) — protect a device.
- [Run a scan](/docs/protector-y-run-a-scan) — scan your device for threats.
- [Quarantine](/docs/protector-y-quarantine) — manage threats Protector Y has isolated.
- [Safe browsing extension](/docs/protector-y-safe-browsing-extension) — block dangerous websites in your browser.
- [Ransomware shield](/docs/protector-y-ransomware-shield) — protect important folders.
- [Secure VPN](/docs/protector-y-secure-vpn) — encrypt your connection.
- [Password manager](/docs/protector-y-password-manager) — store and fill passwords.
- [Identity alerts](/docs/protector-y-identity-alerts) — check if your details appeared in a breach.

## Terms used in Protector Y
- **Malware** — Software designed to harm your device or steal data.
- **Ransomware** — Malware that locks files and demands payment.
- **Quarantine** — A safe place where Protector Y isolates threats.
- **VPN** — An encrypted connection that protects your traffic.
- **False positive** — A safe file flagged by mistake.

## Learn more
- [Protector Y FAQ](/docs/protector-y-faq)
- [Troubleshooting Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-troubleshooting)
- [Protector Y and your privacy](/docs/protector-y-privacy)

## Related articles
- [Get started with Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-get-started) — Everything you need for your first day with Protector Y.
- [Protector Y availability and requirements](/docs/protector-y-availability-and-requirements) — Where Protector Y is available and what you need to use it.

title: Protector Y and your privacy
description: What Protector Y stores and how you control it.
body:
## What Protector Y stores
Protector Y stores information about threats found on your devices, your protected devices list and, if you use it, your encrypted password vault.

## How it's used
To run Protector Y, keep your account secure and, if you allow it, personalise your experience.

## Your controls
- See and download your data from your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
- Delete individual items inside Protector Y.
- Turn off personalised recommendations under Privacy.

## Learn more
- [RanEddie's privacy commitments](/docs/privacy-raneddie-s-privacy-commitments)
- [Download your data](/docs/privacy-download-your-data)

## Children and teens
Younger users get stricter defaults. Parents can manage Protector Y from [Family settings](/docs/families-family-settings-overview).

## AI and your data
Protector Y uses machine-learning models to recognise new threats by how they behave, not just by known signatures. Suspicious files may be checked against Protector Y's cloud service, and you can turn this off.

## How your data is protected
Data stored in RanEddie's cloud is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is protected by your RanEddie ID.

## How long data is kept
We keep your Protector Y data while your account is active. When you delete something, it's removed from active systems promptly and from backups within a limited period.

## Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or download your data. See [Your privacy rights](/docs/privacy-your-privacy-rights).

## Related articles
- [Protector Y availability and requirements](/docs/protector-y-availability-and-requirements) — Where Protector Y is available and what you need to use it.

title: Download or delete your Protector Y data
description: Get a copy of your Protector Y data, or remove it.
body:
## Download a copy
1. Open Privacy in your [Account Center](https://id.raneddie.com/account).
2. Select Download your data.
3. Choose Protector Y and select Create export.

## Delete items
Delete individual items inside Protector Y at any time.

## Delete everything
Deleting your RanEddie ID deletes your Protector Y data too. See [Delete your RanEddie ID](/docs/sign-in-delete-your-raneddie-id).

## What's included in an export
Protector Y exports include information about threats found on your devices, your protected devices list and, if you use it, your encrypted password vault, in common formats you can open with other apps.

## How long it takes
Small exports are ready in minutes. Large ones can take a few days. We'll email you when your download is ready, and the link stays valid for 7 days.

## Before you delete
- Download anything you want to keep.
- Cancel any Protector Y subscriptions.
- Remember that deleting can't be undone after the recovery period.

- Support for screen readers on supported platforms
- Keyboard navigation where a keyboard is available
- Respect for your device's text size, dark mode and reduced motion settings
- Captions wherever Protector Y plays video

## Feedback
Something hard to use? [Report an accessibility problem](/docs/accessibility-report-an-accessibility-problem).

- **macOS** — Protector Y follows the accessibility settings of macOS, including text size, contrast, screen reader and reduce motion where available.

title: Troubleshooting Protector Y
description: Fix common problems with Protector Y.
body:
## Try these first
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Update Protector Y and your device to the latest version.
3. Sign out and sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Restart your device.

## Common problems
- [Installation fails](/docs/protector-y-fix-installation-fails)
- [A scan is very slow](/docs/protector-y-fix-a-scan-is-very-slow)
- [A file I need was quarantined](/docs/protector-y-fix-a-file-i-need-was-quarantined)
- [A safe website is blocked](/docs/protector-y-fix-a-safe-website-is-blocked)
- [An app can't save files](/docs/protector-y-fix-an-app-can-t-save-files)
- [Websites are slow on VPN](/docs/protector-y-fix-websites-are-slow-on-vpn)
- [I forgot my vault password](/docs/protector-y-fix-i-forgot-my-vault-password)
- [I got a breach alert](/docs/protector-y-fix-i-got-a-breach-alert)

## Still need help?
[Get help with Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-get-help).

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Protector Y with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Protector Y.
- If you're using Protector Y in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Protector Y completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Protector Y and for your device.
3. Sign out of Protector Y, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/protector-y-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Protector Y you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

title: Install Protector Y
description: In Protector Y: protect a device.
body:
With Protector Y you can protect a device. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Protector Y on one of its supported platforms: Windows, macOS, Android, Lu devices, Browser extension.
- The latest version of Protector Y and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Download Protector Y for your device.
2. Sign in with your RanEddie ID.
3. Run the first scan.

## Tip
Remove other antivirus software first so they don't conflict.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Protector Y is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Windows, macOS, Android, Lu devices, Browser extension) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- Another antivirus is installed
- The device needs a restart

The quickest fixes:
1. Uninstall other antivirus software.
2. Restart and install again.

For the full guide, see [Installation fails](/docs/protector-y-fix-installation-fails).

## Privacy and security
Protector Y stores information about threats found on your devices, your protected devices list and, if you use it, your encrypted password vault. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your Protector Y data too.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Protector Y with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Protector Y.
- If you're using Protector Y in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

- A false positive

2. Install any available updates for Protector Y and for your device.
3. Sign out of Protector Y, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.

With Protector Y you can store and fill passwords. This article walks you through it step by step, shares tips that make it easier and explains what to do if it doesn't work the way you expect.

## Before you start
- A RanEddie ID. [Create one](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account) if you don't have one yet.
- Protector Y on one of its supported platforms: Windows, macOS, Android, Lu devices, Browser extension.
- The latest version of Protector Y and of your device's software. Updates often fix problems and add improvements.
- An internet connection for signing in, syncing and anything that uses RanEddie's cloud.

## How to
1. Open Protector Y > Passwords and create a vault.
2. Import passwords from your browser.
3. Use the extension to fill and save passwords.

## Tip
Your vault is encrypted with a key only you have — don't forget your vault password.

## Good to know
- Changes are saved to your RanEddie ID, so they follow you to your other devices where Protector Y is available.
- Some options can vary by platform (Windows, macOS, Android, Lu devices, Browser extension) and by country.
- You can come back and change your choices at any time.

## If something goes wrong
The most common reasons are:
- The vault can only be opened with your vault password

The quickest fixes:
1. Use your recovery key if you created one.
2. Otherwise reset the vault and start again.

For the full guide, see [I forgot my vault password](/docs/protector-y-fix-i-forgot-my-vault-password).

## Privacy and security
Protector Y stores information about threats found on your devices, your protected devices list and, if you use it, your encrypted password vault. Everything is tied to your RanEddie ID and protected by it, so a strong password and two-step verification protect your Protector Y data too.

- [Protector Y and your privacy](/docs/protector-y-privacy)
- [Keep your Protector Y account secure](/docs/protector-y-security)

## More you can do in Protector Y
- [Install Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-install-protector-y) — protect a device.
- [Run a scan](/docs/protector-y-run-a-scan) — scan your device for threats.
- [Quarantine](/docs/protector-y-quarantine) — manage threats Protector Y has isolated.
- [Safe browsing extension](/docs/protector-y-safe-browsing-extension) — block dangerous websites in your browser.
- [Ransomware shield](/docs/protector-y-ransomware-shield) — protect important folders.
- [Secure VPN](/docs/protector-y-secure-vpn) — encrypt your connection.
- [Identity alerts](/docs/protector-y-identity-alerts) — check if your details appeared in a breach.

## Terms used in Protector Y
- **Malware** — Software designed to harm your device or steal data.
- **Ransomware** — Malware that locks files and demands payment.
- **Quarantine** — A safe place where Protector Y isolates threats.
- **VPN** — An encrypted connection that protects your traffic.
- **False positive** — A safe file flagged by mistake.

## Related articles

title: I forgot my vault password
description: Protector Y: why this happens and how to fix it.
body:
This article helps when you're using **Password manager** in Protector Y and this happens: *i forgot my vault password*. Work through the sections in order — most people are sorted by the end of the second one.

## Quick checks
Before you go further, these solve many problems in a minute or two:
- Check your internet connection by opening another website or app.
- Make sure you're signed in to Protector Y with the right RanEddie ID.
- Look for an update to Protector Y.
- If you're using Protector Y in a browser, reload the page and turn off content blockers for it.

## Why it happens
- The vault can only be opened with your vault password

## How to fix it
1. Use your recovery key if you created one.
2. Otherwise reset the vault and start again.

## If the problem continues
1. Restart Protector Y completely, then restart your device.
2. Install any available updates for Protector Y and for your device.
3. Sign out of Protector Y, then sign back in with your RanEddie ID.
4. Try on another device or another network to see whether the problem follows you.
5. If nothing helps, [contact support](/docs/protector-y-get-help) — we're happy to look into it.

## What to include when you contact support
- Your RanEddie ID username (never your password).
- The device, operating system and version of Protector Y you're using.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- Any error message, word for word, and a screenshot if you can.
- When the problem started and whether anything changed around that time.

## Prevent it next time
Your vault is encrypted with a key only you have — don't forget your vault password.

Protector Y lets you store and fill passwords. See [Password manager](/docs/protector-y-password-manager) for the full how-to.

title: How RanEddie uses AI
description: Where AI shows up in RanEddie products and what it's for.
body:
Where AI shows up in RanEddie products and what it's for.

## Why it matters
AI can save real time — summarising a long thread, finding a photo, cleaning up audio — but it works best when you understand what it's doing and where its limits are. Knowing how RanEddie's AI features work helps you get better results, spot mistakes early and decide which features you want switched on.

## Overview
AI helps across RanEddie products with tasks like summarising, drafting, recognising what's in photos, recommending what to watch and detecting threats. It's there to save you time — you stay in control of what it does.

## Where you'll find it
- workIT Assist and rEmail Assist for writing and summarising
- EditTime for transcripts, captions and scene detection
- Cloudly Photos for search
- Gimbly's AI director
- Protector Y's threat detection
- Recommendations in BlueBear Stream and RanEddie Games

## Your controls
Most AI features can be turned off in each product's settings. See [Turn AI features on or off](/docs/ai-turn-ai-features-on-or-off).

## Best practices
- Treat AI output as a first draft, not a final answer.
- Give the assistant context: the audience, the tone and the length you want.
- Turn off features you don't use from each product's settings.
- Use thumbs-down or Report when something goes wrong — it helps us improve.

## In each RanEddie product
For product-specific details, see:
- [AI features in Fizz Browser](/docs/fizz-ai-features)
- [AI features in Snake Brawl](/docs/snake-brawl-ai-features)
- [AI features in BlueBear Media](/docs/bluebear-media-ai-features)
- [AI features in Lu](/docs/lu-ai-features)
- [AI features in RanEddie Part](/docs/raneddie-part-ai-features)
- [AI features in SkyPear](/docs/skypear-ai-features)
- [AI features in workIT](/docs/workit-ai-features)
- [AI features in EditTime](/docs/edittime-ai-features)
- [AI features in RanEddie Games](/docs/raneddie-games-ai-features)
- [AI features in Gimbly](/docs/gimbly-ai-features)
- [AI features in Cloudly](/docs/cloudly-ai-features)
- [AI features in RanEddie Invest](/docs/raneddie-invest-ai-features)
- [AI features in rEmail](/docs/remail-ai-features)
- [AI features in baseline](/docs/baseline-ai-features)
- [AI features in Protector Y](/docs/protector-y-ai-features)

## Common questions
**Can I use RanEddie products without AI?**
Yes. Most AI features are optional and can be turned off in each product's settings.

**Does AI see all of my files?**
No. Assistants work on the content you choose to share with them in that moment.

## Related articles
- [RanEddie's AI principles](/docs/ai-raneddie-s-ai-principles) — The commitments behind every AI feature.
- [Turn AI features on or off](/docs/ai-turn-ai-features-on-or-off) — Control AI features across RanEddie products.
- [Review AI-generated content](/docs/ai-review-ai-generated-content) — Why and how to check what AI produces.

The commitments behind every AI feature.

## Why it matters
AI can save real time — summarising a long thread, finding a photo, cleaning up audio — but it works best when you understand what it's doing and where its limits are. AI features should solve a real problem and save real time.

You choose when to use AI, and you can review, edit or reject what it produces.

AI features only use the content you ask them to work on, and your content isn't used to show you ads.

We test AI features for harmful outputs and keep improving them.

title: What is a RanEddie ID?

One account for every RanEddie product.

## Why it matters
Your RanEddie ID is the key to every RanEddie product — your files in Cloudly, your email in rEmail, your games, purchases and devices. Keeping it accurate and secure protects everything connected to it, and knowing how it works makes it easy to get back in if something goes wrong.

## One account
Your RanEddie ID signs you in to Fizz, Snake Brawl, BlueBear Stream, Lu devices, workIT, Cloudly, rEmail and every other RanEddie product.

## What it holds
- Your name, username and photo
- Your email and password
- Security settings
- Connected products and devices

## Get one
[Create a RanEddie ID](/docs/raneddie-id-create-account).

## Best practices
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters — a short phrase works well.
- Keep your email address up to date so codes and alerts reach you.
- Sign in only at id.raneddie.com.
- Save backup codes somewhere safe and offline.

title: RanEddie's privacy commitments
description: How we think about your personal information.
body:
How we think about your personal information.

## Why it matters
Privacy is about knowing what information exists about you and having real control over it. RanEddie products store only what they need to work, and give you tools to see, download and delete your data. Understanding those tools helps you make choices that fit you.

## Our commitments
- We collect what we need to run our products
- We don't sell your personal information
- We don't use the content of your email, documents or files for ads
- You can see, download and delete your data
- We protect your data with strong security

## Best practices
- Review the Privacy section of your Account Center once or twice a year.
- Check which apps and products are connected to your RanEddie ID.
- Clear history you don't need, such as watch history or AI activity.
- Download a copy of your data before you delete anything important.

## In each RanEddie product

title: Security checklist
description: Ten minutes to a safer account.
body:
Ten minutes to a safer account.

## Why it matters
Most account problems start with something small — a reused password, a convincing fake email, an out-of-date device. A few habits make your RanEddie ID, your devices and everything connected to them dramatically harder to break into.

## Do these today
- Use a unique password of at least 15 characters
- Turn on two-step verification
- Review active sessions
- Check your recovery email
- Install updates on your devices
- Install Protector Y

## Best practices
- Use a password manager so every account has a unique password.
- Install updates promptly on every device.
- Open sites yourself instead of clicking links in unexpected messages.
- Back up important files to Cloudly so ransomware can't hold them hostage.

## Why it matters
Most account problems start with something small — a reused password, a convincing fake email, an out-of-date device. A few habits make your RanEddie ID, your devices and everything connected to them dramatically harder to break into.

## Tips
- Use unique passwords
- Turn on two-step verification
- Check connected apps

## Best practices
- Use a password manager so every account has a unique password.
- Install updates promptly on every device.
- Open sites yourself instead of clicking links in unexpected messages.
- Back up important files to Cloudly so ransomware can't hold them hostage.

title: Where your data is stored
description: Where RanEddie products keep your information.
body:
Where RanEddie products keep your information.

## Why it matters
Your files, photos, saves and settings are spread across devices and the cloud. Knowing where each lives, how it syncs and how it's backed up means you can move to a new device, recover from mistakes and free up space without losing anything that matters.

## Cloud products
Cloudly, rEmail, workIT and RanEddie ID store data in RanEddie data centres.

## On your device
Some data, like Snake Brawl progress or Gimbly flight logs, stays on your device unless you back it up.

## Best practices
- Turn on Cloudly Backup for your devices.
- Keep an extra copy of irreplaceable files on an external drive.
- Use version history to undo unwanted changes.
- Name files clearly and keep a small number of top-level folders.

title: Manage your subscriptions
description: See and change everything you pay for.
body:
See and change everything you pay for.

## Why it matters
Subscriptions, one-off purchases and in-app items can add up across products and family members. Knowing where to see every charge, how renewals work and how to change or cancel a plan keeps your spending predictable and makes it easy to fix anything unexpected.

## Steps
1. Open Payments & plans in your Account Center.
2. See every subscription and renewal date.
3. Change or cancel any plan.

## Best practices
- Review Payments & plans every month or two.
- Keep your payment method and billing address up to date.
- Download receipts you may need for expenses or taxes.
- Set budgets and alerts for usage-based Cloudly and baseline billing.

title: Family settings overview
description: One place to manage your family's RanEddie products.
body:
One place to manage your family's RanEddie products.

## Why it matters
Families share devices, subscriptions and screens. Family settings let parents give children the right amount of freedom for their age — with sensible limits on time, spending, content and contact — while still letting the whole household share what they've bought.

## What you can manage
- Screen and play time
- Spending and purchase approvals
- Age ratings for games and video
- Who children can play and chat with
- AI features

## Best practices
- Create separate accounts or profiles for every family member.
- Turn on purchase approvals.
- Review who children can play and chat with.
- Revisit settings as children grow older.

title: Accessibility at RanEddie
description: Our approach to accessible products.
body:
Our approach to accessible products.

## Why it matters
Everyone should be able to use RanEddie products comfortably. Accessibility features — captions, screen-reader support, keyboard navigation, voice control and display settings — make products easier for people with disabilities and more comfortable for everyone.

## Commitment
We design RanEddie products to work for everyone, including people who use assistive technology.

## Feedback
Tell us what would help from any product's Help menu.

## Best practices
- Turn on captions for video and meetings.
- Try keyboard shortcuts on RanEddie websites.
- Use voice control on Lu devices and Gimbly.
- Use dark mode in low light.

title: Build with RanEddie
description: Platforms for developers.
body:
Platforms for developers.

## Why it matters
baseline and Cloudly let you build on the same foundations RanEddie uses. Following the platform's conventions for keys, environments, security rules and monitoring keeps your app reliable and your users' data safe as you grow.

## Platforms
- **baseline** — a complete backend
- **Cloudly** — compute, functions and storage
- **Sign in with RanEddie ID** — authentication for your apps

## Best practices
- Keep secrets on the server and in environment variables.
- Use separate projects or branches for development and production.
- Verify webhook signatures.
- Rotate keys regularly and immediately if one leaks.

## Developer guides
- [Upload files to Cloudly Drive](/docs/cloudly-upload-files-to-cloudly-drive) (Cloudly) — add files and folders to Cloudly Drive.
- [Share a file or folder](/docs/cloudly-share-a-file-or-folder) (Cloudly) — share with people or with a link.
- [Back up your photos](/docs/cloudly-back-up-your-photos) (Cloudly) — back up photos and videos from your phone.
- [Restore deleted files](/docs/cloudly-restore-deleted-files) (Cloudly) — get back files you deleted.
- [Storage plans](/docs/cloudly-storage-plans) (Cloudly) — see and change your storage.
- [Deploy a server with Cloudly Compute](/docs/cloudly-deploy-a-server-with-cloudly-compute) (Cloudly) — create a virtual server.
- [Cloudly Functions](/docs/cloudly-cloudly-functions) (Cloudly) — run code when something happens.
- [Object storage buckets](/docs/cloudly-object-storage-buckets) (Cloudly) — store data for apps in buckets.
- [Create a project](/docs/baseline-create-a-project) (baseline) — start a new baseline project.
- [Create tables](/docs/baseline-create-tables) (baseline) — design your database schema.
- [Row-level security](/docs/baseline-row-level-security) (baseline) — control access to each row.
- [Authentication](/docs/baseline-authentication) (baseline) — add sign-in to your app.
- [Storage buckets](/docs/baseline-storage-buckets) (baseline) — upload and serve files.
- [Realtime](/docs/baseline-realtime) (baseline) — listen to changes as they happen.
- [Edge functions](/docs/baseline-edge-functions) (baseline) — deploy server-side code.
- [Backups and restore](/docs/baseline-backups-and-restore) (baseline) — recover your database.

## Common questions
**Where do I start?**
Create a baseline project — it includes a database, auth, storage and APIs.

**Can I add RanEddie ID sign-in to my app?**
Yes, with the RanEddie ID provider in baseline Auth.

## Related articles
- [Sign in with RanEddie ID for developers](/docs/developers-sign-in-with-raneddie-id-for-developers) — Add RanEddie ID sign-in to your app.
- [API keys and secrets](/docs/developers-api-keys-and-secrets) — Handle credentials safely.
- [Rate limits](/docs/developers-rate-limits) — Request limits for RanEddie APIs.
